+## Score and leaderboards
+
+Score measures the player's performance and is calculated at these milestones:
+
+- **Stage Mode (campaign stages1–4):** when the player completes a stage. Preserve boss-defeat-driven stage progression; score calculation is a completion milestone, not a new timer condition.
+- **Endless Mode (after completing Stage4):** when the player is defeated. Development invincibility can prevent defeat even at0HP; testing score-on-defeat will need an explicit defeat path or invincibility disabled.
+
+Leaderboards display the highest scores for each character. Leaderboard placement, presentation and storage will be specified later. No leaderboard UI, online writes or persistence schema is introduced now. Guest play remains unsaved under the established guest policy.
+
+Pending: the actual score equation, stage-versus-run aggregation, inputs and weights, tie rules, and whether/how Development runs qualify. Earlier boss/mini-boss defeat counts are intended score inputs, but their weights are not yet specified. No score is fabricated from incomplete rules. These milestones are a design specification until the calculation and results flow are implemented.
+
+
+## Score calculation — supplied formula
+
+```text
+baseScore = enemyDefeated*75 + miniBossDefeated*428 + bossDefeated*2251
+          + max(0, finalMinuteValue-30)*20126
+          + min(59, finalMinuteValue)*126
+          + min(59, finalSecondValue)*10 + playerLevel*1219
+hardcoreBonus = hardcore ? floor(baseScore*(finalMinuteValue*0.01 + finalHourValue*1.2)) : 0
+finalScore = floor(baseScore + hardcoreBonus)
+```
+
+Implemented as scoreFormula in game-config.js; edit scoreSettings for coefficients. Inputs are enemyDefeated, miniBossDefeated, bossDefeated, playerLevel, elapsedSeconds and hardcore. Returns baseScore, hardcoreBonus and finalScore. Hardcore defaults false; the helper does not create a Hardcore mode.
+
+The overall enemyDefeated count is the round's visible kill counter. Mini-boss and boss defeat totals are additional run counters; their bonuses supplement that overall count rather than replacing those kills. playerLevel is the level at the scoring milestone.
+
+Timer values are hour/minute/second components: finalHourValue=floor(seconds/3600), finalMinuteValue=floor(seconds/60)%60, finalSecondValue=floor(seconds)%60. The minute-dependent base score therefore resets its minute contribution at an hour boundary, exactly as specified; it does not use total elapsed minutes. Hardcore also includes the supplied independent hour contribution.
+
+Reference-game classifications: post30minute YAGOOs count as mini-bosses; Golden/Silver YAGOOs count as bosses. These are classification notes only; they do not add YAGOOs or assign replacement Blue Archive enemies.
+
+This supplies the previously pending equation. Score snapshots still need results-flow integration, dedicated boss/mini-boss counters, stage-versus-run aggregation policy, leaderboard placement/storage and Development eligibility. No automatic scoring UI or online submission is introduced by the formula helper. Existing milestone rules remain stage completion for campaign and defeat for endless.
+
+
+## Current EXP requirement (supersedes earlier curves)
+
+Start at character level1 with79EXP required for level2. For subsequent levels:
+reqNextLevel = roundEven((4*(currentLevel+1))^2.1) - roundEven((4*currentLevel)^2.1).
+roundEven rounds to nearest integer, choosing the even integer on an exact tie. levelExpFormula/roundToEven implement this; the first requirement is explicitly79. Existing overflow/upgrade choices/fullheal remain.

+### Supernova EX knockback update
+
+The continuous EX can damage each enemy once every0.2seconds, independently of the automatic beam's1second hit cooldown. Each successful EX hit pushes toward the nearest side of the beam, with a small forward component. Sideways travel accounts for beam width, the enemy's projected body radius and32px clearance; forward shove36px; travel/recovery0.2seconds. Centered targets consistently choose one side. Missed hits do not knock back.
+
+Settings are in supernovaSkillSettings. Existing knockback resistance, absolute immunity and enemy/scenery collision stops still apply, so resistant or blocked enemies may remain in the beam. Automatic beam knockback remains unchanged.

+### Event clock, repeats and cleanup
+
+Event starts/range gates use internal campaign time. Repeated bursts continue on their configured active-time cadence while the internal clock remains inside the event window, including clock freezes. They stop once the internal clock passes the end. Range endpoints are inclusive for scheduled repeat waves. The12:45?12:50 row emits188HeavySweepers total over5seconds, not188perframe.
+
+08:30 Heavy Sweeper rings:27members per ring every1.66active seconds, repeating for22seconds. All rings share one event group and expire together at the end; no per-ring22second extension. Other finite lifetimes also use a shared active-gameplay group deadline, independent of internal clock freezes. Expiry invokes existing in-place death fade without knockback, drops, kill credit, score or defeat callbacks. Combat kills before expiry retain their rewards. Global/level-up pause freezes event time; AI pause and the spawning toggle prevent new waves while existing group lifetimes still advance.
+
+Default stats come from the relevant/latest known campaign row even if the type's ordinary spawn window is inactive. Explicit event stats replace just their supplied fields. SPD values are absolute factors of240px/s, not additional multipliers. Mixed Highlander waves cycle1/2/3within each wave. Event enemies never acquire a story checkpoint ID or trigger stage advancement. Normal population limits and cleanup remain; partial placements retry without duplicates. Clusters/stampedes compress spacing for large counts, and rings use legal arcs near playable borders rather than spawning into forbidden map space.

+## Enemy SPD reference
+Enemy table SPD values are ratios of the player's unmodified base travel speed (`playerSettings.speed`, currently 240 pixels/second), not raw pixels/second or the player's upgraded current speed.
+`enemySpeedPxPerSecond = enemySPD * playerSettings.speed`
+Examples: SPD 0.35 = 35% = 84 px/s; SPD 1 = 100% = 240 px/s; SPD 1.5 = 150% = 360 px/s.
+`movementBase` (180) is an internal movement normalization value; it does not change this reference. Player SPD upgrades do not automatically increase enemies' table-based speed.
+
+Event entry rule: all event enemies spawn fully outside the visible viewport, including sprite extent plus a 24px safety gap. Rings surround the viewport perimeter rather than a small circle around the player. Map boundaries restrict formations to legal offscreen entry arcs. Actual insertion rechecks the current camera position after warnings/capacity delays; no shrinking rings into the visible area.
+
+Cluster formation update: scheduled 00:05 Mob cluster now contains20 enemies. Generated cluster events also contain20 (`seededEventSettings.clusterCount`). Cluster geometry uses a filled circular disk with golden-angle spacing rather than a square grid. All event placement still begins fully offscreen.
+

+## Crafters, enhancement and awakening (current)
+Editable rules: `crafterSettings` and the Crafter formula helpers in `game-config.js`. Ground/menu behavior lives in `crafter-system.js`; equipment transactions live in `crafter-rules.js`.
+
+Obtaining: each actual enemy defeat rolls1/1301. Maximum20unconsumed Crafters on the ground; no roll past the cap. Future Credit Card effects can set `player.crafterDropMultiplier` (default1). Safe-ground placement uses the existing loot landing resolver. Crafters use the blue crafting-tablet/gear icon at source rect913,1207,103,134 on `sprites/icons/Game Icon 2.png`. Large white arrows sit above visible Crafters or at the screen edge pointing toward offscreen ones. Crafters are not magnet pickups and clear on map change like other ground items.
+
+Activation: walking within32px opens a paused equipment-selection dialog. Cancel/Escape/right-click preserves the Crafter; leave its radius before reopening. A valid action consumes exactly one Crafter. Cancel, invalid selection or insufficient funds consumes nothing. Admin/Drops and contact damage testing has a Spawn Crafter button.
+
+Upgrading: select any equipped implemented weapon belowMAX for one free level. Equipped items with a definedmaxLevel can gain one free level; they cannot enhance beyondMAX. This does not spend pending level-up choices. Ordinary level-up menus no longer offer awakening.
+
+Awakening: currently only Plana's starting umbrella may awaken, fromLV7, through a separate Crafter choice costing1SecretTechNote. It consumes the Crafter and note, and retains existing golden outline/sparkles. Supernova/other weapon awakening is unavailable. The LV7umbrella guaranteed3xsupercritical upgrade remains distinct from its separate awakening step.
+
+Enhancing: MAX weapons may enhance without a rank cap. Next rank r costs50*rCredits. SuccessChance=min(1,max(0.1,1-0.1*(r-1))+storeBonusPercent/100). Future Enhancement Rate Up uses `player.enhancementRateBonusPercent` (default0). Paid failure loses the Credits and Crafter without increasing rank. Each successful rank adds2base damage divided by primary projectile count. Enhancement damage is added after weapon-level/enchantment/Mod bonuses, does not receive those base bonuses or Growth, and still receives ATK/crit/other final damage multipliers. Automatic Supernova LV7splits over2primary beams; secondary EX/on-hit attacks do not add split count. HUD captions show enhancement ranks.
+
+Future, inactive systems: Crafters Gear extra uses; Credit Card item; Enhancement Rate Up shop purchase; enchantment shop unlock and specific enchantment lists; pre-enchanted offers; synergy weapons and Golden Crafters. No invented enchantment pool or synergy recipe is active. Enchanting, once unlocked, costs250Credits, excludes the starting weapon and replaces previous rolls. Default1enchantment; a GoldenCrafter synergy combining two enchanted MAXweapons may inherit2, including duplicate rolls; reroll replaces both. Compatible enchantment list still to be supplied.
+
+GoldenCrafter design retained: only when at least2MAXweapons have an available synergy combination; at most1on ground. DropChance=(1+minuteTimer/20)/100 (helper `goldenCrafterChance`). Since no synergy recipes exist, GoldenCrafters do not currently spawn.

Editable crafterSettings.glow:height120px,width24px,baseRadius32px,opacity0.75. Visible white arrow sits above the pillar;offscreen directional arrows preserved.

+## Visible crowd spawn threshold

The sidebar displays visible count and current rate live. Existing enemies remain active; this is a spawning throttle rather than forcibly hiding/deleting enemies, so a crowd can exceed 50 as offscreen enemies arrive. The session population cap remains 200. +## Kill-based boss spawning and pity
+boss-spawner.js maintains an internal boss-charge counter separate from HUD total kills. Each real enemy defeat while no boss was alive adds one charge. Starting at charge1000, each eligible kill rolls a 0.01% chance. The chance stays at that value through2500, then rises linearly toward100% at3000. A successful roll queues a randomly selected Iroha or Shiroko chasing boss at a valid offscreen entrance. Placement retries once per second if no location/slot is currently available; pending progress is not lost. Boss spawning is updated before ordinary spawn batches.
+
+Any successful boss spawn, including manual admin spawns, resets the internal charge to0. Charge never accumulates while any boss lives, including the kill that defeats that boss. Cleanup/admin deletion grants no charge. This freeze also applies in endless mode, per user clarification. Before endless, all spawn paths enforce one living boss. In the development cycle, advancing from Stage4 back to Stage1 marks endless mode, where manual multi-boss tests are allowed; automatic progression still waits for all bosses to die. New Game resets the mode/counter. The playtesting sidebar shows charge, chance, pending state and boss-alive freeze. No boss spawn changes the HUD's lifetime kill total.

+Tune bossSpawnSettings (1000 unlock,0.0001 base probability,2500 pity start,3000 guarantee) in boss-spawner.js. Boss HP/combat behavior retains its existing development settings. The standard pause freezes this system with all gameplay.

+# Synergy recipes for Golden Crafters
+
+Golden Crafters are implemented. The live recipe list in `synergy-recipes.js` includes **Supernova + Luminous Nova ? The Princess and the Key**. Both ingredients must be MAX level. The synergy has no EX skill yet.
+
+A recipe needs:
+
+- `id`: unique recipe identifier.
+- `ingredients`: two weapon IDs. Both must be equipped and at their own MAX level.
+- `result`: the synergy weapon descriptor, including `id`, `name`, `icon` and `maxLevel`.
+- Optional `description` for the fusion preview.
+- Optional `createWeapon()` returning a fresh, fully initialized result weapon. Its ID must match `result.id`.
+
+Weapon damage/attacks and any new EX skill still need their normal weapon-controller implementation; a recipe only defines a valid fusion. Do not register a recipe for an unimplemented weapon.
+
+On confirmation the two ingredients become one result weapon in the earlier slot; the second slot becomes empty. No Credits or pending level-up choices are spent. One Golden Crafter is consumed. Cancellation or a stale/invalid pair leaves it intact. One enchantment from each ingredient is preserved, including duplicate enchantments, for a maximum of two inherited enchantments.
+
+Automatic drops roll `(1 + fullRunMinutes / 20) / 100` per enemy defeat, only while an eligible recipe exists and no Golden Crafter is on the ground. The admin **Spawn Golden Crafter** button bypasses recipe eligibility for visual/menu testing, while retaining the one-drop limit. Without a valid recipe its menu cannot fuse or consume weapons.

+const path = coordinates => coordinates.map(([x, y]) => ({ x, y }));

+  1: [path([[30, 20], [50, 0], [50, 100]])],

+/** Match handwritten 1â€“6 locally, without downloading or calling either AI model. */
+export function recognizeAdminDigit(strokes) {
+  const bounds = drawingBounds(strokes);
+  if (!bounds) return null;
+  const width = bounds.right - bounds.left, height = bounds.bottom - bounds.top;
+  if (height > 0 && width / height < .18) return 1;
+  const ranked = Object.entries(adminDigitTemplates).map(([digit, template]) =>
+    ({ digit: Number(digit), score: drawingAccuracy(strokes, template) })).sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
+  return ranked[0].score >= .45 && ranked[0].score - ranked[1].score >= .025 ? ranked[0].digit : null;
+}
+
+/** Resolve a slot only when it contains a weapon with an implemented EX effect. */
+export function adminSkillResult(player, slot) {
+  const weapon = player.attackSlots?.[slot];
+  const skillId = skillIds[weapon?.id];
+  return skillId ? { valid: true, adminTest: true, weapon, skillId,
+    label: weapon.name || weapon.id, score: 1, accuracy: skillCastSettings.accuracyAverage,
+    damageMultiplier: skillCastSettings.damageAverage, components: [] }
+    : { valid: false, reason: `Slot ${slot + 1} has no implemented EX skill.` };
+}

+import { bossBehaviorSettings } from './game-config.js';
+import { gifFrameAt } from './gif-animation.js';
+import { spriteDisplayPadding, normalSpriteSize } from './scene-metrics.js';
+/** Fit the whole sheet once; narrower attack crops must never enlarge individual frames. */
+export function lineupSheetScale(template) {
+  const layout=template.layout;
+  let width=0,height=0;
+  for(let frame=0;frame<layout.columnEdges.length-1;frame++) {
+    for(let row=0;row<layout.rowEdges[frame].length-1;row++) {
+      const crop=layout.frames?.[row]?.[frame];
+      width=Math.max(width,crop?.width ?? layout.columnEdges[frame+1]-layout.columnEdges[frame]);
+      height=Math.max(height,crop?.height ?? layout.rowEdges[frame][row+1]-layout.rowEdges[frame][row]);
+    }
+  }
+  return Math.min(((template.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize)-spriteDisplayPadding*2)/(template.referenceSize||215),200/width,205/height);
+}

+import { arisWeaponSettings, attackTimeFormula, supernovaSkillSettings, arisBeamVisualSettings } from './game-config.js';
+import { statMultiplier, ensureCombatStats, rollAttackDamage, totalWeaponDamage } from './combat-stats.js';
+import { getAllEnemies, getEnemy, damageEnemy } from './world-state.js';
+import { getCombatHitbox, getEnemyHurtbox, segmentHitsBody } from './combat-hitboxes.js';
+import { applySkillControl } from './enemy-control.js';
+import { drawFiringRings } from './firing-rings.js';
+
+/** Create Supernova with independent automatic and EX attacks. */
+export function createArisWeapon() {
+  return { id: 'aris-laser', name: 'Supernova', icon: '../sprites/attacks/Weapon_Icon_Arisu.png',
+    level: 1, iconRotation: -45, exSkill: true };
+}
+
+/** Find the equipped laser, independently of every other automatic weapon. */
+export function getArisWeapon(player) {
+  return player.attackSlots?.find(weapon => weapon?.id === 'aris-laser');
+}
+
+/** Size bonuses add to base width; level7 adds a rear beam to each volley. */
+export function arisLevelStats(player) {
+  const level = Math.max(1, Math.min(7, getArisWeapon(player)?.level || 1));
+  return { level, size: 1 + (level >= 2 ? .3 : 0) + (level >= 6 ? .5 : 0),
+    damage: level >= 4 ? 1.5 : 1,
+    interval: arisWeaponSettings.attackInterval - (level >= 3 ? .5 : 0) - (level >= 5 ? .5 : 0),
+    beams: level >= 7 ? 2 : 1 };
+}
+
+/** Roll the supplied27-33base damage range, then weapon levels and player ATK/crit. */
+export function rollArisDamage(player, random = Math.random, target, damageMod = 1) {
+  const s = arisWeaponSettings;
+  return rollAttackDamage(player, totalWeaponDamage(player, 'aris-laser', s.damageMultiplier,
+    [(arisLevelStats(player).damage - 1) * 100],
+    { projectileCount: arisLevelStats(player).beams, hitCooldownFrames: s.hitCooldown * 60 }), random, { target, damageMod });
+}
+
+/** Invisible piercing capsule starts at the player, bridging the decorative muzzle gap. */
+export function arisBeamHits(enemy, origin, angle, width, length = arisWeaponSettings.beamLength) {
+  const body = getEnemyHurtbox(enemy);
+  return segmentHitsBody({ ...body, rx: body.rx + width / 2, ry: body.ry + width / 2 },
+    origin.x, origin.y, origin.x + Math.cos(angle) * length, origin.y + Math.sin(angle) * length);
+}
+
+/** Own an independent automatic laser cycle alongside all other equipped autoattacks. */
+export function createArisAttack({getWeapon=getArisWeapon,specialHitCooldown=supernovaSkillSettings.hitCooldown,
+  rollSpecialDamage=(player,enemy,multiplier)=>rollArisDamage(player,Math.random,enemy,multiplier),onSpecialHit=()=>{}}={}) {
+  let autoattackEnabled = true;
+  let special = null;
+  let owner = null, cooldown = 0, clock = 0, volleys = [];
+  const hitTimes = new Map();
+  function clear() { special = null; owner = null; cooldown = 0; clock = 0; volleys = []; hitTimes.clear(); }
+  const s = arisWeaponSettings;
+  const image = new Image();
+  image.src = new URL('../sprites/attacks/Weapon_Icon_Arisu.png', import.meta.url).href;
+  const ready = image.decode();
+  return {
+    ready,
+    reset: clear,
+    /** Remove automatic volleys only; an active EX continues updating and dealing damage. */
+    setAutoattackEnabled(enabled) { autoattackEnabled=Boolean(enabled); if(!autoattackEnabled) volleys=[]; },
+    /** Start a continuous, independently aimable EX; shared per-target cooldown prevents frame damage. */
+    cast(player, angle, damageMultiplier = 1.5, getAngle = () => angle) {
+      if (owner !== player) { clear(); owner = player; }
+      volleys = []; // Cancel the current automatic beam before the EX opening.
+      special = { player, angle, getAngle, damageMultiplier, elapsed: 0, hits: new Map() };
+    },
+    update(delta, player, aim) {
+      if (!getWeapon(player)) { clear(); return; }
+      if (owner !== player) { clear(); owner = player; }
+      clock += delta;
+      if (special) {
+        special.elapsed += delta;
+        special.angle = special.getAngle();
+        if (supernovaBeamPhase(special.elapsed).finished || special.player !== player) special = null;
+      }
+      for (const [id, time] of hitTimes) if (clock-time > s.hitCooldown+s.beamSeconds) hitTimes.delete(id);
+      if (autoattackEnabled && !special) cooldown = Math.max(0, cooldown - delta);
+      if (autoattackEnabled && !special && cooldown <= 0) {
+        const stats = arisLevelStats(player);
+        volleys.push({ elapsed: 0, angles: stats.beams === 2 ? [aim, aim + Math.PI] : [aim],
+          width: s.beamWidth * stats.size, origin: arisBeamAnchor(player) });
+        cooldown = attackTimeFormula(stats.interval, ensureCombatStats(player).hastePercent);
+      }
+      const active = [...volleys];
+      if (special && supernovaBeamPhase(special.elapsed).damaging) active.push({ elapsed: special.elapsed, angles: [special.angle], width: supernovaSkillSettings.beamWidth,
+        origin: arisBeamAnchor(player), special: true });
+      for (const volley of active) {
+        const start = volley.elapsed;
+        volley.elapsed += delta;
+        volley.origin = arisBeamAnchor(player);
+        if (volley.special || start < s.beamSeconds) for (const enemy of getAllEnemies()) {
+          const times = volley.special ? special.hits : hitTimes;
+          const lastHit = times.get(enemy.id);
+          if (lastHit !== undefined && clock - lastHit < (volley.special ? specialHitCooldown : s.hitCooldown) - 1e-8) continue;
+          const angle = volley.angles.find(value => arisBeamHits(enemy, volley.origin, value, volley.width));
+          if (angle === undefined) continue;
+          times.set(enemy.id, clock); // A missed attack also cannot reroll every frame.
+          const hit = volley.special?rollSpecialDamage(player,enemy,special.damageMultiplier):rollArisDamage(player,Math.random,enemy,1);
+          const landed = damageEnemy(enemy.id, hit.damage, player, hit.type, { canMiss: true });
+          if(volley.special&&landed!==false)onSpecialHit(enemy,hit,player);
+          const living = getEnemy(enemy.id);
+          if (landed !== false && living) {
+            if (volley.special) {
+              const control = supernovaKnockback(living, volley.origin, angle, volley.width);
+              applySkillControl(living, control.x, control.y, supernovaSkillSettings.knockbackSeconds,
+                supernovaSkillSettings.knockbackSeconds,
+                { ignoreKnockbackResistance: supernovaSkillSettings.ignoreKnockbackResistance });
+            } else {
+              const distance = s.knockbackSpeed * s.knockbackSeconds;
+              applySkillControl(living, Math.cos(angle) * distance, Math.sin(angle) * distance,
+                s.knockbackSeconds, s.knockbackSeconds, { ignoreKnockbackResistance: s.ignoreKnockbackResistance });
+            }
+          }
+        }
+      }
+      volleys = volleys.filter(volley => volley.elapsed < s.beamSeconds * arisBeamVisualSettings.durationMultiplier);
+    },
+    draw(context, camera) {
+      const visible = [...volleys];
+      const phase = special ? supernovaBeamPhase(special.elapsed) : null;
+      if (special && image.naturalWidth) {
+        // This entire pass is drawn before the player: the gun emerges from behind her.
+        const pose = supernovaWeaponPose(special.elapsed, special.player, special.angle);
+        context.save();
+        const anchor = arisBeamAnchor(special.player);
+        context.translate(anchor.x-camera.x, anchor.y-camera.y);
+        context.rotate(special.angle);
+        context.globalAlpha = pose.opacity;
+        const height = pose.length * image.naturalHeight/image.naturalWidth;
+        context.shadowColor = '#63eaff'; context.shadowBlur = 12*pose.opacity;
+        context.drawImage(image, pose.offset-pose.length/2, -height/2, pose.length, height);
+        if(special.elapsed>=arisBeamVisualSettings.openingSeconds&&phase.beamAge<0) {
+          const charge=Math.min(1,(special.elapsed-arisBeamVisualSettings.openingSeconds)/arisBeamVisualSettings.prelaunchSeconds);
+          const muzzle=arisBeamOffset(anchor,special.angle,true)+supernovaSkillSettings.beamStartAdjustment;
+          const radius=4+12*charge;
+          context.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';context.shadowBlur=0;
+          const light=context.createRadialGradient(muzzle,0,0,muzzle,0,radius*2);
+          light.addColorStop(0,'rgba(235,255,255,.85)');light.addColorStop(.4,'rgba(90,215,255,.4)');light.addColorStop(1,'rgba(50,160,255,0)');
+          context.fillStyle=light;context.beginPath();context.arc(muzzle,0,radius*2,0,Math.PI*2);context.fill();
+          context.strokeStyle='rgba(160,240,255,.6)';context.lineWidth=1;
+          context.beginPath();context.arc(muzzle,0,24*(1-charge)+3,0,Math.PI*2);context.stroke();
+          for(let i=0;i<5;i++) {
+            const angle=i*Math.PI*2/5+special.elapsed*2,distance=8+(1-charge)*24;
+            context.beginPath();context.arc(muzzle+Math.cos(angle)*distance,Math.sin(angle)*distance,1.2,0,Math.PI*2);context.fill();
+          }
+        }
+        context.restore();
+      }
+      if(special&&phase.beamAge>=0) {
+        const anchor=arisBeamAnchor(special.player),muzzle=arisBeamOffset(anchor,special.angle,true)+supernovaSkillSettings.beamStartAdjustment;
+        drawFiringRings(context,anchor.x-camera.x+Math.cos(special.angle)*muzzle,
+          anchor.y-camera.y+Math.sin(special.angle)*muzzle,special.angle,phase.beamAge,supernovaSkillSettings.beamWidth*.55,true);
+      }
+      if (special && phase.beamAge >= 0 && !phase.beamFinished) visible.push({ elapsed: phase.beamAge, angles: [special.angle], origin: arisBeamAnchor(special.player),
+        width: supernovaSkillSettings.beamWidth, special: true });
+      for (const volley of visible) {
+        const activeDuration = volley.special ? supernovaSkillSettings.duration : s.beamSeconds;
+        const visualDuration = activeDuration * arisBeamVisualSettings.durationMultiplier;
+        const collapse = Math.max(.06, visualDuration-activeDuration);
+        const pulse = 1 + arisBeamVisualSettings.pulseDepth *
+          Math.sin(volley.elapsed*Math.PI*2*arisBeamVisualSettings.pulsesPerSecond) ** 8;
+        const thickness = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, volley.elapsed/.025,
+          (visualDuration-volley.elapsed)/collapse)) * pulse;
+        for (const angle of volley.angles) {
+          context.save();
+          context.translate(volley.origin.x - camera.x, volley.origin.y - camera.y);
+          context.rotate(angle);
+          // Shift only the EX light cone toward the gun; the weapon emergence stays anchored.
+          const offset = arisBeamOffset(volley.origin,angle,volley.special) +
+            (volley.special ? supernovaSkillSettings.beamStartAdjustment : 0);
+          const cone = arisBeamVisualSettings.coneLength;
+          // Additive bloom spreads blue/cyan light around the beam without changing its hit area.
+          const visual = arisBeamVisualSettings;
+          const layers = [
+            [visual.bloomSpread, `rgba(36,151,255,${visual.bloomOpacity})`, visual.bloomBlur, 'lighter'],
+            [2.1, `rgba(112,243,255,${visual.bloomOpacity})`, visual.bloomBlur*.5, 'lighter'],
+            [2.2, '#219bff88', visual.outerBlur, 'source-over'],
+            [1.3, '#51e6ffdd', visual.innerBlur, 'source-over'],
+            [.55, '#f1ffff', 1.5, 'source-over']
+          ];
+          for (const [scale, color, blur, blend] of layers) {
+            context.globalCompositeOperation = blend;
+            const half = volley.width * scale * thickness / 2;
+            context.filter = `blur(${blur}px)`;
+            context.fillStyle = color;
+            // Curved shoulders and a rounded nose soften the former triangular opening.
+            context.beginPath(); context.moveTo(offset, 0);
+            context.bezierCurveTo(offset, -half*.35, offset+cone*.45, -half, offset+cone, -half);
+            context.lineTo(s.beamLength, -half); context.lineTo(s.beamLength, half);
+            context.lineTo(offset+cone, half);
+            context.bezierCurveTo(offset+cone*.45, half, offset, half*.35, offset, 0);
+            context.closePath(); context.fill();
+          }
+          context.restore();
+        }
+      }
+    }
+  };
+}
+
+
+/** Sweep toward the closest beam edge, plus a small forward shove.
+ * Include projected body radius so even large enemies clear the beam at zero resistance.
+ * Shared knockback still respects resistance, collisions and absolute immunity.
+ */
+export function supernovaKnockback(enemy, origin, angle, width) {
+  const body = getCombatHitbox(enemy, true);
+  const forwardX = Math.cos(angle), forwardY = Math.sin(angle);
+  const sideX = -forwardY, sideY = forwardX;
+  const offset = (body.x-origin.x)*sideX + (body.y-origin.y)*sideY;
+  const sign = offset < 0 ? -1 : 1;
+  const radius = Math.hypot(body.rx*sideX, body.ry*sideY);
+  const distance = Math.max(0, width/2 + radius + supernovaSkillSettings.knockbackClearance - Math.abs(offset));
+  return {
+    x: sideX*sign*distance + forwardX*supernovaSkillSettings.forwardKnockback,
+    y: sideY*sign*distance + forwardY*supernovaSkillSettings.forwardKnockback
+  };
+}
+
+
+/** Pure presentation timing; only the active3seconds authorize EX damage. */
+export function supernovaBeamPhase(elapsed) {
+  const openingDuration = arisBeamVisualSettings.openingSeconds + arisBeamVisualSettings.prelaunchSeconds;
+  const beamAge = elapsed-openingDuration;
+  return { openingDuration, beamAge,
+    damaging: beamAge >= 0 && beamAge < supernovaSkillSettings.duration,
+    beamFinished: beamAge >= supernovaSkillSettings.duration * arisBeamVisualSettings.durationMultiplier,
+    finished: beamAge >= supernovaSkillSettings.duration * arisBeamVisualSettings.durationMultiplier +
+      arisBeamVisualSettings.weaponReturnSeconds };
+}
+
+
+/** Fade and slide out from the player's center, hold through firing/tail, then return. */
+export function supernovaWeaponPose(elapsed, player = {label:'Plana',x:0,y:0}, angle = 0) {
+  const visual = arisBeamVisualSettings;
+  const phase = supernovaBeamPhase(elapsed);
+  const smooth = value => { const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, value)); return t*t*(3-2*t); };
+  const emerge = smooth(elapsed/visual.openingSeconds);
+  const returnStart = phase.openingDuration + supernovaSkillSettings.duration*visual.durationMultiplier;
+  const returning = smooth((elapsed-returnStart)/visual.weaponReturnSeconds);
+  const progress = emerge*(1-returning);
+  return {opacity:progress, offset:(arisBeamOffset(arisBeamAnchor(player),angle,true)-visual.weaponLength/2)*progress,
+    length:visual.weaponLength};
+}
+
+
+/** Use the real player collider center, including its vertical sprite offset. */
+export function arisBeamAnchor(player) { return getCombatHitbox(player, false); }
+
+/** Automatic beam starts 10px beyond the collider; EX adds its independent muzzle gap. */
+export function arisBeamOffset(anchor, angle, special = false) {
+  const rx = Math.max(anchor.rx || 0, 0.000001), ry = Math.max(anchor.ry || 0, 0.000001);
+  return 1/Math.hypot(Math.cos(angle)/rx,Math.sin(angle)/ry) + supernovaSkillSettings.hitboxGap + (special ? supernovaSkillSettings.extraMuzzleGap : 0);
+}

+import { font21Metrics } from './font21-metrics.js';
+import { font2Metrics } from './font2-metrics.js';
+import { thinFontMetrics } from './font-thin-metrics.js';
 import { fontMetrics } from './font-metrics.js';
+const highlightedGlyphs=new Map();
+
+/** Important EX values/effects use yellow ink, without changing the wording or wrapping. */
+export function statHighlightRanges(text) {
+  return [...text.matchAll(/\d+(?:\.\d+)?\s*(?:%|×|x\b)?|\b(?:seconds?|critical chance|noncritical|stunning|knocking enemies aside|unlimited piercing|stored[- ]charge|ATK)\b/gi)]
+    .map(match=>({start:match.index,end:match.index+match[0].length}));
+}
+
+/** Tint bright glyph ink once and preserve the original dark outline and transparency. */
+function yellowGlyph(image,glyph,variant,character) {
+  const key=`${variant}:${character}`;if(highlightedGlyphs.has(key))return highlightedGlyphs.get(key);
+  const tile=document.createElement('canvas');tile.width=glyph.width;tile.height=glyph.height;
+  const context=tile.getContext('2d',{willReadFrequently:true});
+  context.drawImage(image,glyph.x,glyph.y,glyph.width,glyph.height,0,0,glyph.width,glyph.height);
+  const pixels=context.getImageData(0,0,tile.width,tile.height);
+  for(let i=0;i<pixels.data.length;i+=4)if(pixels.data[i]>160&&pixels.data[i+1]>160&&pixels.data[i+2]>160) {
+    pixels.data[i]=255;pixels.data[i+1]=225;pixels.data[i+2]=90;
+  }
+  context.putImageData(pixels,0,0);highlightedGlyphs.set(key,tile);return tile;
+}

+import { bossBehaviorSettings as settings, contactSettings } from './game-config.js';
+import { damagePlayer } from './player-stats.js';
+import { getCombatHitbox } from './combat-hitboxes.js';
+
+/** Boss action state, projectiles and warned area attacks; Shiroko keeps ordinary chase AI. */
+export function createBossBehaviors() {
+  const bullets=[],zones=[];
+  function hit(player,amount) {
+    if(player.contactIFrames>0)return;
+    if(damagePlayer(player,amount))player.contactIFrames=contactSettings.iFrameDuration;
+  }
+  function fire(npc,angle,speed,radius=5) {
+    if(bullets.length>=settings.projectileLimit)return;
+    bullets.push({owner:npc.id,x:npc.x,y:npc.y,previousX:npc.x,previousY:npc.y,
+      vx:Math.cos(angle)*speed,vy:Math.sin(angle)*speed,radius,age:0,damage:npc.contactDamage||1});
+  }
+  function zone(npc,x,y,delay,radius) { zones.push({owner:npc.id,x,y,remaining:delay,radius,damage:npc.contactDamage||1}); }
+  function begin(npc,name,extra={}) { npc.bossAction={name,elapsed:0,...extra};npc.gifElapsed=0;npc.moving=false; }
+  function finish(npc) {npc.bossAction=null;npc.bossSquash=1;npc.bossVisualOffsetY=0;npc.attack=null;}
+  /** Return true while this controller owns movement; otherwise use ordinary chasing. */
+  function updateNpc(npc,player,delta,viewport) {
+    const s=settings[npc.type];
+    if(!s||!npc.ai||delta<=0)return false;
+    npc.bossCooldown=(npc.bossCooldown??s.interval)-delta;
+    if(!npc.bossAction&&npc.bossCooldown<=0) {
+      npc.bossCooldown=s.interval;npc.bossMoveIndex=(npc.bossMoveIndex||0)+1;
+      if(npc.type==='arisu')begin(npc,'chargeUp',{clip:'charge'});
+      if(npc.type==='iroha') {
+        const name=npc.bossMoveIndex%2?'cannon':'artillery';begin(npc,name);
+        npc.attack={name,facing:npc.facing||'left',elapsed:0,walkElapsed:npc.elapsed||0};
+      }
+      if(npc.type==='neru')begin(npc,npc.bossMoveIndex%2?'shoot':'compress',npc.bossMoveIndex%2?{clip:'shoot',nextBullet:0}:{});
+    }
+    const action=npc.bossAction;if(!action)return false;
+    action.elapsed+=delta;npc.moving=false;
+    if(action.name==='chargeUp'&&action.elapsed>=s.chargeUpSeconds) {
+      const angle=Math.atan2(player.y-npc.y,player.x-npc.x);
+      begin(npc,'charge',{angle,distance:Math.hypot(viewport.width,viewport.height)+npc.spriteSize});
+    } else if(action.name==='charge') {
+      const distance=Math.min(s.chargeSpeed*delta,action.distance);
+      const x=npc.x,y=npc.y;npc.x+=Math.cos(action.angle)*distance;npc.y+=Math.sin(action.angle)*distance;action.distance-=distance;
+      npc.facing=Math.cos(action.angle)<0?'left':'right';npc.moving=true;
+      const body=getCombatHitbox(player,false),dx=npc.x-x,dy=npc.y-y;
+      const t=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,((body.x-x)*dx+(body.y-y)*dy)/(dx*dx+dy*dy||1)));
+      if(Math.hypot(body.x-x-dx*t,body.y-y-dy*t)<body.rx+30)hit(player,npc.contactDamage||1);
+      // Stop after crossing the far viewport edge, never home during a charge.
+      const outside=npc.x<viewport.x-80||npc.x>viewport.x+viewport.width+80||npc.y<viewport.y-80||npc.y>viewport.y+viewport.height+80;
+      if(action.distance<=0||(action.elapsed>.2&&outside))begin(npc,'recover');
+    } else if(action.name==='recover') {
+      if(action.elapsed>=s.recoverySeconds)finish(npc);
+    } else if(npc.type==='iroha') {
+      if(npc.attack)npc.attack.elapsed=action.elapsed*1000;
+      if(!action.fired&&action.elapsed>=.4) {
+        action.fired=true;
+        if(action.name==='cannon')fire(npc,Math.atan2(player.y-npc.y,player.x-npc.x),420,12);
+        else for(const [dx,dy] of [[0,0],[-100,60],[100,60]])zone(npc,player.x+dx,player.y+dy,s.artilleryDelay,s.artilleryRadius);
+      }
+      if(action.elapsed>=(action.name==='cannon'?s.cannonSeconds:s.artillerySeconds))finish(npc);
+    } else if(action.name==='shoot') {
+      while(action.nextBullet<=Math.min(action.elapsed,s.shootSeconds)) {
+        for(let i=0;i<s.bulletCount;i++)fire(npc,i/s.bulletCount*Math.PI*2+action.nextBullet*1.3,s.bulletSpeed);
+        action.nextBullet+=s.bulletInterval;
+      }
+      if(action.elapsed>=s.shootSeconds)finish(npc);
+    } else if(action.name==='compress') {
+      npc.bossSquash=1-.45*Math.min(1,action.elapsed/s.compressSeconds);
+      if(action.elapsed>=s.compressSeconds) {
+        begin(npc,'leap',{fromX:npc.x,fromY:npc.y,targetX:player.x,targetY:player.y});
+        zone(npc,player.x,player.y,s.leapSeconds,s.landingRadius);npc.bossSquash=1;
+      }
+    } else if(action.name==='leap') {
+      const t=Math.min(1,action.elapsed/s.leapSeconds);
+      npc.x=action.fromX+(action.targetX-action.fromX)*t;npc.y=action.fromY+(action.targetY-action.fromY)*t;
+      npc.bossVisualOffsetY=-Math.sin(Math.PI*t)*s.leapHeight;
+      if(t>=1){npc.bossVisualOffsetY=0;begin(npc,'recover');}
+    }
+    return true;
+  }
+  /** Advance attacks with swept projectile checks and the player's shared damage I-frames. */
+  function updateEffects(delta,player,alive) {
+    const body=getCombatHitbox(player,false),live=new Set(alive.map(n=>n.id));
+    for(let i=bullets.length-1;i>=0;i--) {
+      const b=bullets[i];b.age+=delta;b.previousX=b.x;b.previousY=b.y;b.x+=b.vx*delta;b.y+=b.vy*delta;
+      const dx=b.x-b.previousX,dy=b.y-b.previousY;
+      const t=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,((body.x-b.previousX)*dx+(body.y-b.previousY)*dy)/(dx*dx+dy*dy||1)));
+      const touching=Math.hypot(body.x-b.previousX-dx*t,body.y-b.previousY-dy*t)<body.rx+b.radius;
+      if(touching&&delta>0)hit(player,b.damage);
+      if(touching&&delta>0||b.age>settings.projectileLifetime||!live.has(b.owner))bullets.splice(i,1);
+    }
+    for(let i=zones.length-1;i>=0;i--) {
+      const z=zones[i];z.remaining-=delta;
+      if(!live.has(z.owner)){zones.splice(i,1);continue;}
+      if(z.remaining<=0){if(Math.hypot(body.x-z.x,body.y-z.y)<z.radius+body.rx)hit(player,z.damage);zones.splice(i,1);}
+    }
+  }
+  /** Draw attack cues and bullets in world space, with no hitstop or gameplay pauses. */
+  function draw(context,camera) {
+    context.save();context.lineWidth=2;
+    for(const z of zones){context.strokeStyle='#ff5264';context.fillStyle='rgba(255,60,90,.12)';context.beginPath();context.arc(z.x-camera.x,z.y-camera.y,z.radius,0,Math.PI*2);context.fill();context.stroke();}
+    for(const b of bullets){context.fillStyle='#61deff';context.strokeStyle='#e5fcff';context.beginPath();context.arc(b.x-camera.x,b.y-camera.y,b.radius,0,Math.PI*2);context.fill();context.stroke();}
+    context.restore();
+  }
+  return {updateNpc,updateEffects,draw,get projectileCount(){return bullets.length;},get zoneCount(){return zones.length;}};
+}

+import { bossCatchupSettings } from './game-config.js';
+export { bossCatchupSettings } from './game-config.js';
+import { isBossEnemy, enemyViewportDistance } from './world-state.js';
+import { statMultiplier } from './combat-stats.js';
+
+
+
+/** Boost distant chasing bosses above player speed until their sprite re-enters view. */
+export function updateBossCatchup(enemy, player, camera, width, height, baseSpeed = 180) {
+  if (!isBossEnemy(enemy) && !enemy.campaignGuardian) return;
+  const distance = enemyViewportDistance(enemy, camera, width, height);
+  if (distance > bossCatchupSettings.distance) enemy.catchingUp = true;
+  if (distance === 0) enemy.catchingUp = false;
+  const playerSpeed = baseSpeed * (player.movementSpeedMultiplier || 1) * statMultiplier(player, 'spdPercent');
+  const enemySpeed = baseSpeed * (enemy.movementSpeedMultiplier || 1) * statMultiplier(enemy, 'spdPercent');
+  enemy.catchupSpeed = enemy.catchingUp && enemy.ai && enemy.behavior === 'chase'
+    ? Math.max(enemySpeed * bossCatchupSettings.baseMultiplier,
+      playerSpeed * bossCatchupSettings.playerMultiplier + bossCatchupSettings.extraSpeed) : 0;
+}

+import { bossChanceFormula, bossPityThresholds, enemyTypeStats, eventTriggerSettings } from './game-config.js';
+import { bossSpawnSettings } from './game-config.js';
+export { bossSpawnSettings } from './game-config.js';
+import { bossSpriteSize } from './scene-metrics.js';
+import { getAllEnemies, isBossEnemy, onEnemySpawn, onEnemyDefeat } from './world-state.js';
+import { offscreenSpawnPoint } from './playtest-spawner.js';
+
+
+
+/** Endless kill totals are separate from the boss-charge counter. */
+export function bossWaveLimit(endlessKills) {
+  return endlessKills >= bossSpawnSettings.thirdBossUnlockKills
+    ? bossSpawnSettings.unlockedWaveSize : bossSpawnSettings.waveSize;
+}
+
+/** Pick distinct bosses only; missing future roster entries never become duplicates. */
+export function selectBossWave(stage, endless, endlessKills, roster, random = Math.random) {
+  const available = [...new Set(roster)];
+  if (!endless) {
+    const preferred = bossTypeForStage(stage, random);
+    return available.includes(preferred) ? [preferred] : available.slice(0, 1);
+  }
+  for (let i = available.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
+    const j = Math.floor(random() * (i + 1));
+    [available[i], available[j]] = [available[j], available[i]];
+  }
+  return available.slice(0, bossWaveLimit(endlessKills));
+}
+
+/** Stage 1 always uses Shiroko; unassigned stages retain the current test roster. */
+export function bossTypeForStage(stage, random = Math.random) {
+  return stage.id === 'first' ? 'shiroko' : random() < 0.5 ? 'iroha' : 'shiroko';
+}
+
+/** Chance per eligible kill; switch to the shorter pity curve at 5 minutes after Stage 4. */
+export function bossChance(kills, endlessSeconds = null) {
+  return bossChanceFormula(kills, endlessSeconds);
+}
+
+/** Keep progression separate from total run kills and freeze it while bosses live. */
+export function createBossCharge(random = Math.random, getEndlessSeconds = () => null) {
+  let kills = 0, pending = false;
+  return {
+    recordDefeat(bossWasAlive) {
+      if (bossWasAlive || pending) return;
+      kills++;
+      const chance = bossChance(kills, getEndlessSeconds());
+      if (chance > 0 && (chance >= 1 || random() < chance)) pending = true;
+    },
+    // Reaching 5 endless minutes can make the existing kill count immediately guaranteed.
+    refresh(bossAlive = false) {
+      if (!bossAlive && kills >= bossPityThresholds(getEndlessSeconds()).guaranteedKills) pending = true;
+    },
+    get thresholds() { return bossPityThresholds(getEndlessSeconds()); },
+    reset() { kills = 0; pending = false; },
+    get kills() { return kills; },
+    get pending() { return pending; },
+    get chance() { return bossChance(kills, getEndlessSeconds()); }
+  };
+}
+
+/** Spawn an offscreen chasing boss after a successful kill roll, retrying blocked spots. */
+export function createBossSpawner({ canvas, camera, getStage, spawnBoss, slotsRemaining, onSpawn, isEndless,
+  getSurvivalSeconds = () => 0, automaticEnabled = () => true, getBossTypes = () => ['shiroko', 'iroha'], getEndlessSeconds = () => null, canSpawnWave = () => true }) {
+  const charge = createBossCharge(Math.random, getEndlessSeconds);
+  const status = document.querySelector('#boss-spawn-status');
+  const details = document.querySelector('#boss-spawn-details');
+  let retry = 0;
+  let endlessKills = 0;
+  let waveQueue = [];
+  let firstBossSpawned = false;
+  const timedFirstStage = () => !isEndless() && getStage().id === 'first';
+
+  function updateStatus() {
+    const alive = getAllEnemies().filter(isBossEnemy).length;
+    const state = alive ? `Frozen: ${alive} boss alive.` : !eventTriggerSettings.enabled && !waveQueue.length ? 'Legacy automatic event triggers disabled.' : timedFirstStage() && !waveQueue.length ? 'Shiroko scheduled at 05:00.' : alive ? `Frozen: ${alive} boss alive.` : waveQueue.length || charge.pending ? 'Boss wave ready.'
+      : `${(charge.chance * 100).toFixed(2)}% chance per kill.`;
+    const text = `Boss charge: ${charge.kills}/${charge.thresholds.guaranteedKills}\n${state}\n${isEndless() ? `Endless kills: ${endlessKills}` : 'Stages 1–4'}`;
+    if (status.textContent !== text) status.textContent = text;
+    if (details) details.textContent = `Boss wave: ${isEndless() ? Math.min(bossWaveLimit(endlessKills), new Set(getBossTypes()).size) : 1}. Unlocked slots: ${isEndless() ? bossWaveLimit(endlessKills) : 1}. Pity starts: ${charge.thresholds.pityStart} kills. Unique boss types: ${new Set(getBossTypes()).size}. Waiting to place: ${waveQueue.length}.`;
+  }
+  const stopSpawn = onEnemySpawn(enemy => {
+    if (isBossEnemy(enemy)) {
+      if (timedFirstStage() && enemy.type === 'shiroko') firstBossSpawned = true;
+      charge.reset();
+      waveQueue = waveQueue.filter(type => type !== enemy.type);
+      updateStatus();
+    }
+  });
+  const stopDefeat = onEnemyDefeat(({ bossesAliveBefore }) => {
+    if (isEndless()) endlessKills++;
+    if (eventTriggerSettings.enabled && !timedFirstStage()) charge.recordDefeat(bossesAliveBefore > 0 || waveQueue.length > 0);
+    updateStatus();
+  });
+
+  /** Keep guaranteed spawns pending until a valid offscreen spot and slot exist. */
+  function update(delta) {
+    if (eventTriggerSettings.enabled && !timedFirstStage()) charge.refresh(getAllEnemies().some(isBossEnemy) || waveQueue.length > 0);
+    updateStatus();
+    retry = Math.max(0, retry - delta);
+    if (retry > 0 || slotsRemaining() <= 0) return;
+    if (!waveQueue.length) {
+      if (!eventTriggerSettings.enabled) return;
+      if (!canSpawnWave()) return;
+      if (getAllEnemies().some(isBossEnemy)) return;
+      if (timedFirstStage()) {
+        if (firstBossSpawned || !automaticEnabled() || getSurvivalSeconds() < enemyTypeStats.shiroko.spawnAtSeconds) return;
+      } else if (!charge.pending) return;
+      waveQueue = selectBossWave(getStage(), isEndless(), endlessKills, getBossTypes());
+    }
+    if (!waveQueue.length) return;
+    retry = bossSpawnSettings.retryInterval;
+    const stage = { ...getStage(), spawnMargin: 150, spawnRadius: bossSpriteSize / 2 };
+    let spawned = false;
+    for (const type of [...waveQueue]) {
+      if (slotsRemaining() <= 0) break;
+      if (getAllEnemies().some(enemy => isBossEnemy(enemy) && enemy.type === type)) {
+        waveQueue = waveQueue.filter(entry => entry !== type);
+        continue;
+      }
+      for (let attempt = 0; attempt < bossSpawnSettings.placementAttempts; attempt++) {
+        const point = offscreenSpawnPoint(stage, camera, canvas.width, canvas.height);
+        if (point && spawnBoss(type, point.x, point.y)) {
+          waveQueue = waveQueue.filter(entry => entry !== type);
+          charge.reset();
+          spawned = true;
+          break;
+        }
+      }
+    }
+    if (spawned) onSpawn();
+    updateStatus();
+  }
+  updateStatus();
+  return { update,
+    requestWave() {
+      if (getAllEnemies().some(isBossEnemy) || waveQueue.length) return false;
+      waveQueue = selectBossWave(getStage(), isEndless(), endlessKills, getBossTypes());
+      charge.reset();
+      retry = 0;
+      return waveQueue.length > 0;
+    },
+    get hasPendingWave() { return waveQueue.length > 0; },
+    get endlessKills() { return endlessKills; }, dispose() { stopSpawn(); stopDefeat(); } };
+}

+import { playerSettings, eliteSizeMultiplier, normalSpriteSize } from './game-config.js';
+import { campaignSettings, campaignEnemyRows } from './campaign-config.js';
+
+/** Own the internal chart clock; survival time and gameplay continue during clock freezes. */
+export function createCampaignSchedule() {
+ let stage='first',seconds=campaignSettings.stageStarts.first;
+ let spawned=new Set(),defeated=new Set();
+ const rows=()=>campaignEnemyRows.filter(row=>row.stage===stage);
+ const required=()=>rows().filter(row=>row.kind==='boss'||row.gate);
+ const cleared=()=>required().length>0 && required().every(row=>defeated.has(row.id));
+ const fighting=()=>rows().some(row=>(row.kind==='boss'||row.gate)&&spawned.has(row.id)&&!defeated.has(row.id));
+ const frozen=()=>rows().some(row=>row.freeze&&seconds>=row.start)&&!cleared();
+ return {
+  get seconds(){return seconds;},get stage(){return stage;},get frozen(){return frozen();},
+  get fightingBoss(){return fighting();},get cleared(){return cleared();},
+  get readyToAdvance(){return cleared()&&(stage!=='second'||seconds>=campaignSettings.stageStarts.third);},
+  setStage(id){if(id===stage)return;stage=id;seconds=campaignSettings.stageStarts[id]??0;spawned=new Set();defeated=new Set();},
+  update(delta,spawnEncounter){
+   if(!frozen()) {
+    const next=seconds+Math.max(0,delta);
+    const gate=rows().filter(row=>row.freeze&&!defeated.has(row.id)&&row.start>=seconds).sort((a,b)=>a.start-b.start)[0];
+    seconds=gate?Math.min(next,gate.start):next;
+   }
+   for(const row of rows()) if(row.kind!=='regular'&&seconds>=row.start&&!spawned.has(row.id)) {
+    if(spawnEncounter(row))spawned.add(row.id);
+   }
+  },
+  profileFor(type){return rows().filter(row=>row.enemies.includes(type)&&row.start<=seconds).at(-1) || rows().find(row=>row.enemies.includes(type)) || null;},
+  recordDefeat(enemy){if(enemy.campaignRowId)defeated.add(enemy.campaignRowId);},
+  /** Ordinary selection keeps running while the internal chart clock is frozen. */
+  pickSpawn(random=Math.random){
+   let pool=rows().filter(row=>row.kind==='regular'&&seconds>=row.start&&seconds<row.end);
+   if(stage==='fourth'&&seconds>=campaignSettings.endlessRandomFrom) {
+    const latest=new Map();
+    for(const row of campaignEnemyRows.filter(r=>r.kind==='regular')) for(const type of row.enemies)latest.set(type,{...row,enemies:[type]});
+    pool=[...latest.values()];
+   }
+   if(!pool.length) pool=rows().filter(row=>row.kind==='regular'&&seconds>=row.start).slice(-1);
+   if(!pool.length)return null;
+   let row=pool[Math.min(pool.length-1,Math.floor(random()*pool.length))];
+   const type=row.enemies[Math.min(row.enemies.length-1,Math.floor(random()*row.enemies.length))];
+   let enemy=type,mega=Boolean(row.mega);
+   if(fighting()&&random()<campaignSettings.megaChanceDuringBoss){
+    const dedicated=rows().find(r=>r.kind==='mini'&&r.baseEnemy===type);
+    if(dedicated){row=dedicated;enemy=dedicated.enemies[0];}else mega=true;
+   }
+   return {row,type:enemy,mega,scheduled:false};
+  }
+ };
+}
+
+
+/** Exact chart stats override legacy stage/type multipliers; only random Mega rolls add bonuses. */
+export function campaignEnemyOverrides(entry, template, baseMovementSpeed = playerSettings.movementBase) {
+ const row=entry.row;
+ const boosted=Boolean(entry.mega && !row.mega);
+ return {label:boosted?`Mega ${template.label || 'Enemy'}`:template.label, hp:row.hp*(boosted?10:1),maxHp:row.hp*(boosted?10:1),
+  contactDamage:row.atk*(boosted?2:1),contactDamageMultiplier:1,
+  movementSpeedMultiplier:row.spd*playerSettings.speed/baseMovementSpeed,
+  expReward:row.exp,perTypeStats:true,
+  miniBoss:row.kind==='mini'||Boolean(row.mega)||boosted,boss:row.kind==='boss',
+  elite:row.kind==='mini'||Boolean(row.mega)||boosted,
+  spriteSize:(template.spriteSize||normalSpriteSize)*((boosted||row.endless&&row.mega)&&!template.miniBoss?(template.megaSizeMultiplier ?? eliteSizeMultiplier):1),
+  campaignRowId:entry.scheduled?row.id:null,campaignGuardian:Boolean(row.gate),campaignOverride:true};
+}

+/** Shared stat labels, icons and formatting for Pause and Crafter screens. */
+export const characterStatRows = [

+import { combatBalance } from './game-config.js';
+import { normalSpriteSize, spriteDisplayPadding } from './scene-metrics.js';
+
+// EDIT half-width, half-height and center offset as fractions of display size.
+// Ellipses exclude transparent corners while covering more of the visible body.
+export const combatHitboxes = {
+  plana: { rx: 0.27, ry: 0.38, y: 0.03, playerOffsetY: 6, playerRadiusScale: 0.72 }, // Pixels downward for the controlled player.
+  arona: { rx: 0.25, ry: 0.39, y: 0.03 },
+  // Small foot-level ellipse: tune rx/ry for size; feet keeps it at the sprite baseline.
+  midori: { rx: 0.13, ry: 0.075, radiusSize: normalSpriteSize, feet: true },
+  yuuka: { rx: 0.25, ry: 0.42, y: 0.02 },
+  mob: { rx: 0.28, ry: 0.28, y: 0.04, eliteOffsetY: 6, normalOffsetY: 6 }, // Circular Mob collider; elite variants scale the same profile.
+  iroha: { rx: 0.44, ry: 0.29, y: 0.06 },
+  shiroko: { rx: 0.30, ry: 0.30, y: 0.05 } // Center on the visible body below the halo.
+};
+
+/** Return a stable body ellipse, scaling automatically for elite/boss sizes. */
+export function getCombatHitbox(character, enemy = Boolean(character.id)) {
+  const name = (character.type || character.label || 'mob').toLowerCase();
+  const key = Object.keys(combatHitboxes).find(type => name.includes(type)) || 'mob';
+  const profile = character.combatHitbox || combatHitboxes[key];
+  const size = character.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize;
+  const hitboxScale = enemy ? combatBalance.enemyHitboxScale : 1;
+  const radiusSize = profile.radiusSize || size;
+  const rx = radiusSize * profile.rx * hitboxScale * (enemy ? 1 : profile.playerRadiusScale || 1);
+  // Compress player height to the existing half-width, producing a centered circle.
+  const ry = enemy ? radiusSize * profile.ry * hitboxScale : rx;
+  // Foot-anchored profiles retain their small dimensions when the artwork grows.
+  const offsetY = !enemy ? (profile.playerOffsetY || 0) : profile.feet ? size / 2 - spriteDisplayPadding - ry : size * profile.y;
+  const eliteOffsetY = enemy ? (character.elite ? profile.eliteOffsetY || 0 : profile.normalOffsetY || 0) : 0;
+  return { x: character.x, y: character.y + offsetY + eliteOffsetY, rx, ry };
+}
+
+/** Damage-receiving sprite bounds are separate from the small contact-damage ellipse. */
+export function getEnemyHurtbox(character) {
+  const size=character.spriteSize||normalSpriteSize;
+  const bounds=character.spriteHurtbox||{offsetX:0,offsetY:0,width:size-spriteDisplayPadding*2,height:size-spriteDisplayPadding*2};
+  const oval=bounds.mask?.ellipse;
+  if(oval)return {x:character.x+bounds.offsetX+(oval.x-.5)*bounds.width*(bounds.mirrored?-1:1),
+    y:character.y+bounds.offsetY+(oval.y-.5)*bounds.height,
+    rx:oval.rx*bounds.width,ry:oval.ry*bounds.height,shape:'ellipse',
+    coverage:oval.coverage,emptyFraction:oval.emptyFraction,meetsTargets:oval.meetsTargets};
+  return {x:character.x+bounds.offsetX,y:character.y+bounds.offsetY,
+    rx:Math.max(1,bounds.width/2),ry:Math.max(1,bounds.height/2),shape:'rectangle',
+    mask:bounds.mask,mirrored:bounds.mirrored,maskWidth:bounds.width,maskHeight:bounds.height};
+}
+
+/** Test a segment against sprite rectangles or the existing contact ellipses. */
+export function segmentHitsBody(body, x1, y1, x2, y2) {
+  if(body.shape==='rectangle') {
+    let near=0,far=1;
+    for(const [start,end,center,radius] of [[x1,x2,body.x,body.rx],[y1,y2,body.y,body.ry]]) {
+      const delta=end-start;
+      if(Math.abs(delta)<1e-10){if(start<center-radius||start>center+radius)return false;continue;}
+      let a=(center-radius-start)/delta,b=(center+radius-start)/delta;
+      if(a>b)[a,b]=[b,a];near=Math.max(near,a);far=Math.min(far,b);
+      if(near>far)return false;
+    }
+    if(!body.mask)return true;
+    // The broad crop rectangle overlaps; now require actual opaque sprite pixels.
+    const padX=Math.max(0,body.rx-body.maskWidth/2),padY=Math.max(0,body.ry-body.maskHeight/2);
+    return body.mask.some(run=>segmentHitsBody({shape:'rectangle',
+      x:body.x+(run.x-.5)*body.maskWidth*(body.mirrored?-1:1),
+      y:body.y+(run.y-.5)*body.maskHeight,
+      rx:run.width*body.maskWidth/2+padX,ry:run.height*body.maskHeight/2+padY},x1,y1,x2,y2));
+  }
+  const x = (x1 - body.x) / body.rx, y = (y1 - body.y) / body.ry;
+  const dx = (x2 - x1) / body.rx, dy = (y2 - y1) / body.ry;
+  const length = dx * dx + dy * dy;
+  const t = length ? Math.max(0, Math.min(1, -(x * dx + y * dy) / length)) : 0;
+  return (x + dx * t) ** 2 + (y + dy * t) ** 2 <= 1;
+}

+import { percentBonusFormula, attackDamageFormula, weaponDamageFormula, growthSettings, totalATKFormula, attackStatSettings, totalCritModFormula, bonusDamageTakenFormula, damageBonusFormula, damageReductionFormula, haloDamageFormula, damageModifiersFormula } from './game-config.js';
+import { defaultCombatStats, combatBalance } from './game-config.js';
+export { defaultCombatStats } from './game-config.js';
+// Percent bonuses: zero keeps base values. CRIT is a direct chance percentage.
+
+
+/** Initialize independent per-character combat stats without resetting upgrades. */
+export function ensureCombatStats(character) {
+  character.combatStats ??= {};
+  character.combatStats.damageBonusMultipliers ??= [];
+  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(defaultCombatStats)) character.combatStats[key] ??= value;
+  return character.combatStats;
+}
+
+/** Convert a bonus percentage to a multiplier (25% means 1.25 times base). */
+export function statMultiplier(character, key) {
+  const value = Number(ensureCombatStats(character)[key]);
+  if (key === 'atkPercent') return totalCharacterATK(character) / 100;
+  return percentBonusFormula(value);
+}
+
+/** Roll per-hit critical chance; target debuffs add percentage points before clamping. */
+export function rollAttackDamage(character, totalWeaponDamage, random = Math.random,
+  { damageMod = 1, forceCritical = false, targetCritBonus = 0, criticalMultiplier, weaponCritDamagePercent = 0, target } = {}) {
+  const stats = ensureCombatStats(character);
+  const buffs=Object.values(character.combatBuffs||{}).filter(Boolean);
+  const bonusCrit=buffs.reduce((sum,buff)=>sum+(Number(buff.critPercent)||0),0);
+  const critical = forceCritical || random() < Math.max(0, Math.min(100, stats.critPercent + bonusCrit + targetCritBonus)) / 100;
+  const combinedModifier = damageModifiersFormula({
+    criticalMultiplier: critical ? characterCriticalMultiplier(character, criticalMultiplier, weaponCritDamagePercent) : 1,
+    bonusDamageTaken: bonusDamageTakenFormula(target?.bonusDamageTakenPercent ?? []),
+    DB: damageBonusFormula([...stats.damageBonusMultipliers,...buffs.map(buff=>buff.damageBonusMultiplier).filter(Number.isFinite)]),
+    DR: damageReductionFormula(target?.damageReductionPercent ?? []),
+    halo: characterHaloMultiplier(character, target),
+    attackModifier: damageMod // Attack-specific effects, including EX drawing accuracy.
+  });
+  return { damage: attackDamageFormula(totalWeaponDamage, totalCharacterATK(character), combinedModifier, random),
+    critical, type: critical ? 'critical' : 'normal' };
+}
+
+/** Build weapon damage with independent level bonuses and optional purchased Growth.
+ * mainWeaponId can explicitly identify a character main weapon; Plana defaults to her umbrella.
+ */
+export function totalWeaponDamage(character, weaponId, base, bonusesPercent = [], options = {}) {
+  const mainWeaponId = character.mainWeaponId ?? (character.label === 'Plana' ? 'plana-umbrella' : null);
+  const weapon=character.attackSlots?.find(item=>item?.id===weaponId);
+  return weaponDamageFormula(base, bonusesPercent, {
+    ...options, enhancementRank:weapon?.enhancementRank ?? 0, growthEligible: weaponId === mainWeaponId,
+    growthRank: character.growthRank ?? growthSettings.defaultRank, playerLevel: character.level ?? 1
+  });
+}
+
+
+/** Add the accumulated item/skill ATK bonus to the character's independent base ATK. */
+export function totalCharacterATK(character) {
+  return totalATKFormula(character.baseATK ?? attackStatSettings.baseATK,
+    [Number(ensureCombatStats(character).atkPercent)]);
+}
+
+
+/** Add character and weapon critical damage bonuses; overrides replace only the base.
+ * criticalMultiplier is an optional weapon base override (e.g. Umbrella LV7=3).
+ * critDamagePercent contains accumulated bonuses, separate from critical chance.
+ */
+export function characterCriticalMultiplier(character, criticalMultiplier, weaponBonus = 0) {
+  const base = criticalMultiplier !== undefined ? (criticalMultiplier - 1) * 100 :
+    (character.baseCritMod ?? (combatBalance.criticalMultiplier - 1) * 100);
+  const bonus = ensureCombatStats(character).critDamagePercent;
+  return Math.max(0, 1 + totalCritModFormula(base, [bonus, weaponBonus]) / 100);
+}
+
+
+/** Measure character-to-target world distance at the hit, never from projectile origin. */
+export function characterHaloMultiplier(character, target) {
+  if (!target || ![character.x, character.y, target.x, target.y].every(Number.isFinite)) return 1;
+  return haloDamageFormula(Math.hypot(target.x - character.x, target.y - character.y), character.haloLevel ?? 0);
+}

+import { crafterSettings, crafterEnhancementCost, crafterEnhancementChance, umbrellaUpgradeSettings, arisWeaponSettings } from './game-config.js';
+import { getLootTotals, spendCredits, spendSecretTechNotes } from './exp-drops.js';
+import { recordWeaponMax } from './weapon-max-order.js';

+/** List only equipped targets, keeping item upgrades capped and awakening main-weapon-only. */
+export function crafterChoices(player) {
+  const choices=[],loot=getLootTotals();
+  for(const [kind,slots] of [['weapon',player.attackSlots||[]],['item',player.equipmentSlots||[]]]) {
+    slots.forEach((target,index)=>{
+      if(!target)return;
+      const max=target.id==='plana-umbrella'?umbrellaUpgradeSettings.maxLevel:
+        target.id==='aris-laser'?arisWeaponSettings.maxLevel:target.maxLevel;
+      if(!Number.isFinite(max))return;
+      const prefix=`${kind}:${index}`,name=target.name||target.id||'Item',level=target.level||1;
+      if(!target.isSynergy&&level<max)choices.push({id:`${prefix}:level`,target,kind,name,label:`Upgrade to LV ${level+1}`,cost:0,disabled:false});
+      else if(kind==='weapon') {
+        const rank=(target.enhancementRank||0)+1,cost=crafterEnhancementCost(rank);
+        const chance=crafterEnhancementChance(rank,player.enhancementRateBonusPercent||0);
+        choices.push({id:`${prefix}:enhance`,target,kind,name,label:`Enhance +${rank} — ${cost} Credits — ${Math.round(chance*100)}% success`,cost,chance,rank,disabled:loot.credits<cost});
+      }
+      const main=player.mainWeaponId??(player.label==='Plana'?'plana-umbrella':null);
+      if(kind==='weapon'&&target.id==='plana-umbrella'&&main===target.id&&level>=max&&!target.awakened) {
+        choices.push({id:`${prefix}:awaken`,target,kind,name,label:`Awaken — ${umbrellaUpgradeSettings.awakeningNoteCost} Secret Tech Note`,disabled:loot.secretTechNotes<umbrellaUpgradeSettings.awakeningNoteCost});
+      }
+    });
+  }
+  return choices;
+}
+
+/** A valid attempt consumes one Crafter even when a paid enhancement fails. */
+export function applyCrafterChoice(player,id,random=Math.random) {
+  const choice=crafterChoices(player).find(c=>c.id===id);
+  if(!choice||choice.disabled)return {consumed:false,success:false,message:'That upgrade is unavailable.'};
+  const action=id.split(':').at(-1),target=choice.target;
+  if(action==='level') {target.level=(target.level||1)+1;if(choice.kind==='weapon')recordWeaponMax(player,target);return {consumed:true,success:true,message:`${choice.name} upgraded to LV ${target.level}.`};}
+  if(action==='awaken') {
+    if(!spendSecretTechNotes(umbrellaUpgradeSettings.awakeningNoteCost))return {consumed:false,success:false};
+    target.awakened=true;return {consumed:true,success:true,message:`${choice.name} awakened!`};
+  }
+  if(!spendCredits(choice.cost))return {consumed:false,success:false};
+  const success=random()<choice.chance;
+  if(success)target.enhancementRank=choice.rank;
+  return {consumed:true,success,message:success?`${choice.name} enhanced to +${choice.rank}!`:`Enhancement failed. ${choice.cost} Credits and the Crafter were consumed.`};
+}

+import { goldenCrafterChoices, applyGoldenCrafterChoice } from './golden-crafter-rules.js';

+/** Shared draw/contact rectangle, including the icon's scale and upward ground offset. */
+export function crafterSpriteBounds(drop) {
+  const scale=crafterSettings.iconScale;
+  return {left:drop.x-18*scale,right:drop.x+18*scale,top:drop.y-46*scale,bottom:drop.y+scale};
+}
+
+/** Inclusive swept segment/rectangle test, so fast movement cannot skip a Crafter. */
+function segmentTouchesRectangle(from,to,box) {
+  let enter=0,exit=1;
+  for(const [start,end,min,max] of [[from.x,to.x,box.left,box.right],[from.y,to.y,box.top,box.bottom]]) {
+    const delta=end-start;
+    if(Math.abs(delta)<1e-10){if(start<min||start>max)return false;continue;}
+    const a=(min-start)/delta,b=(max-start)/delta;
+    enter=Math.max(enter,Math.min(a,b));exit=Math.min(exit,Math.max(a,b));
+    if(enter>exit)return false;
+  }
+  return true;
+}
+
+/** Sweep the real player ellipse against the visible icon, with rounded-corner accuracy. */
+export function crafterTouchesPlayer(drop,player,previous=player,padding=0) {
+  const body=getCombatHitbox(player,false),from=getCombatHitbox({...player,x:previous.x,y:previous.y},false);
+  const sprite=crafterSpriteBounds(drop);
+  const box={left:sprite.left-padding,right:sprite.right+padding,top:sprite.top-padding,bottom:sprite.bottom+padding};
+  // The Minkowski sum of a rectangle and ellipse is two bars plus four elliptical corners.
+  if(segmentTouchesRectangle(from,body,{...box,left:box.left-body.rx,right:box.right+body.rx})||
+    segmentTouchesRectangle(from,body,{...box,top:box.top-body.ry,bottom:box.bottom+body.ry}))return true;
+  return [box.left,box.right].some(x=>[box.top,box.bottom].some(y=>
+    segmentHitsBody({x,y,rx:body.rx,ry:body.ry},from.x,from.y,body.x,body.y)));
+}

+/** Steady white ground glow and soft cyan-white pillar; purely visual, with no flashing. */
+export function drawCrafterGlow(context,x,y,golden=false) {
+  const glow=crafterSettings.glow;
+  context.save();context.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';context.globalAlpha=glow.opacity;
+  if(golden)context.filter='sepia(1) saturate(4)';
+  // Stretch a radial falloff into a narrow pillar, extending below and above the icon.
+  context.save();context.translate(x,y-glow.pillarHeight*.45);
+  context.scale(glow.pillarWidth/(glow.pillarHeight+24),1);
+  const pillar=context.createRadialGradient(0,0,0,0,0,glow.pillarHeight*.6);
+  pillar.addColorStop(0,'rgba(235,255,255,.6)');pillar.addColorStop(.35,'rgba(135,245,255,.32)');pillar.addColorStop(1,'rgba(100,235,255,0)');
+  context.fillStyle=pillar;context.fillRect(-glow.pillarHeight,-glow.pillarHeight,glow.pillarHeight*2,glow.pillarHeight*2);context.restore();
+  const core=context.createLinearGradient(0,y-glow.pillarHeight,0,y+8);
+  core.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,255,255,0)');core.addColorStop(.3,'rgba(235,255,255,.12)');core.addColorStop(.85,'rgba(255,255,255,.45)');core.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,255,255,0)');
+  context.fillStyle=core;context.fillRect(x-3,y-glow.pillarHeight,6,glow.pillarHeight+8);
+  // Flatten the base into a luminous pool of light on the ground.
+  context.globalAlpha=Math.min(1,glow.opacity*1.2);
+  context.translate(x,y+2);context.scale(1,.32);
+  const base=context.createRadialGradient(0,0,0,0,0,glow.baseRadius);
+  base.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,255,255,.95)');base.addColorStop(.3,'rgba(255,255,255,.65)');base.addColorStop(.65,'rgba(150,245,255,.3)');base.addColorStop(1,'rgba(120,235,255,0)');
+  context.fillStyle=base;context.fillRect(-glow.baseRadius,-glow.baseRadius,glow.baseRadius*2,glow.baseRadius*2);
+  context.restore();
+}

+/** Run-scoped, non-magnetic Crafter drops and the paused, cancellable upgrade menu. */
+export function createCrafterSystem({getPlayer,canvas,onOpen=()=>{},onChange=()=>{},onResult=()=>{},golden=false,getMinuteTimer=()=>0}) {
+  const drops=new Map();let nextId=0,active=null,ignoreUntilLeave=null;
+  const toast=document.createElement('div');toast.className='crafter-toast';toast.setAttribute('role','status');toast.hidden=true;canvas.parentElement.append(toast);let toastTimer;
+  const icon=new Image();icon.src=crafterSettings.icon.source;
+  const ready=icon.decode();
+  /** Close without consuming; require leaving its pickup radius before reopening. */
+  function close() {ignoreUntilLeave=active;active=null;menu.close();canvas.focus({preventScroll:true});}
+  const menu=createCrafterMenu({canvas,getPlayer,golden,onCancel:close,onAction:id=>{
+    if(active===null||!drops.has(active))return;
+    const result=golden?applyGoldenCrafterChoice(getPlayer(),id):applyCrafterChoice(getPlayer(),id);
+    if(!result.consumed){menu.refresh();return;}
+    drops.delete(active);close();onChange();
+    // Successful fusion is shown directly by the new inventory weapon, without an alert.
+    if(golden&&result.success)return;
+    onResult(result.message);
+    toast.textContent=result.message;toast.hidden=false;clearTimeout(toastTimer);toastTimer=setTimeout(()=>{toast.hidden=true},4000);
+  }});
+  function open(drop) {active=drop.id;onOpen();menu.open();}
+  /** Place on safe ground, respecting the twenty-Crafter limit even for test drops. */
+  function spawn(x,y) {
+    if(drops.size>=(golden?crafterSettings.goldenMaxGround:crafterSettings.maxGround))return false;
+    const point=safeDropLanding(x,y);if(!point)return false;
+    const drop={id:++nextId,...point};drops.set(drop.id,drop);return drop;
+  }
+  function roll(enemy,random=Math.random) {
+    if(drops.size>=(golden?crafterSettings.goldenMaxGround:crafterSettings.maxGround))return false;
+    // Credit Card can later supply this multiplier without changing the base drop chance.
+    if(golden&&!goldenCrafterChoices(getPlayer()).length)return false;
+    const chance=golden?goldenCrafterChance(getMinuteTimer()):Math.min(1,crafterSettings.dropChance*Math.max(0,getPlayer().crafterDropMultiplier??1));
+    return random()<chance?spawn(enemy.x,enemy.y):false;
+  }
+  /** Walk onto a Crafter to open it; cancellation does not destroy the ground object. */
+  function update(player,previous) {
+    if(active!==null)return;
+    for(const drop of drops.values()) {
+      if(ignoreUntilLeave===drop.id) {
+        if(!crafterTouchesPlayer(drop,player,player,crafterSettings.reentryPadding))ignoreUntilLeave=null;
+        continue; // Leaving after Cancel must not immediately reactivate via the swept path.
+      }
+      if(crafterTouchesPlayer(drop,player,previous||player)){open(drop);break;}
+    }
+  }
+
+  /** Draw the source-sheet icon and a large white directional triangle, clamped at screen edges. */
+  function draw(context,camera,width,height) {
+    if(!icon.naturalWidth)return;
+    const crop=crafterSettings.icon;
+    for(const drop of drops.values()) {
+      const x=drop.x-camera.x,y=drop.y-camera.y;
+      if(x>-40&&x<width+40&&y>-60&&y<height+crafterSettings.glow.pillarHeight)drawCrafterGlow(context,x,y,golden);
+      const bounds=crafterSpriteBounds(drop);
+      if(x>-40&&x<width+40&&y>-60&&y<height+40) {
+        context.save();if(golden)context.filter='sepia(1) saturate(4)';
+        context.drawImage(icon,crop.x,crop.y,crop.width,crop.height,
+          bounds.left-camera.x,bounds.top-camera.y,bounds.right-bounds.left,bounds.bottom-bounds.top);context.restore();
+      }
+      const offscreen=x<20||x>width-20||y<20||y>height-20;
+      let ax=x,ay=Math.max(28,y-crafterSettings.glow.pillarHeight-18),angle=Math.PI/2;
+      if(offscreen) {
+        const dx=x-width/2,dy=y-height/2;
+        const scale=Math.min((width/2-30)/Math.max(.001,Math.abs(dx)),(height/2-30)/Math.max(.001,Math.abs(dy)));
+        ax=width/2+dx*scale;ay=height/2+dy*scale;angle=Math.atan2(dy,dx);
+      }
+      context.save();context.translate(ax,ay);context.rotate(angle);context.fillStyle=golden?'#ffeaa0':'#fff';context.strokeStyle=golden?'#b88b20':'#1d719c';context.lineWidth=2;
+      // Local +X is the tip; rotation points down at visible Crafters or toward offscreen ones.
+      context.beginPath();context.moveTo(22,0);context.lineTo(-14,-17);context.lineTo(-14,17);context.closePath();context.fill();context.stroke();context.restore();
+    }
+  }
+  return {ready,spawn,roll,update,draw,get active(){return active!==null;},get count(){return drops.size;},
+    clear(){drops.clear();ignoreUntilLeave=null;if(active!==null)close();}};

+import { damageNumberSettings } from './game-config.js';
+export { damageNumberSettings } from './game-config.js';
+import { fontMetrics } from './font-metrics.js';
+
+const numbers = [];
+const textCache = new Map();
+let font;
+
+/** Load one shared bitmap font for all damage numbers. */
+export function loadDamageNumberGraphics() {
+  font = new Image();
+  font.src = '../sprites/font.png';
+  return font.decode();
+}
+
+/** Format normal hits, yellow critical hits, or red supercrit visuals. */
+export function damageNumberStyle(amount, player = false, hitType = 'normal') {
+  if (hitType === 'miss') return { text: 'MISS', color: '#ffffff', italic: true };
+  const text = String(Math.round(amount * 100) / 100);
+  if (player) return { text, color: '#ff5265', italic: false };
+  if (hitType === 'supercritical') return { text: `${text}!!!`, color: '#ff5265', italic: true, scale: 1.1 };
+  if (hitType === 'critical') return { text: `${text}!`, color: '#ffe15a', italic: true, scale: 1.1 };
+  return { text, color: '#ffffff', italic: false };
+}
+
+/** Queue a damage popup; supercritical styling does not define its trigger. */
+export function showDamageNumber(target, amount, player = false, hitType = 'normal', group = null) {
+  if ((!(amount > 0) && hitType !== 'miss') || !Number.isFinite(amount) || !Number.isFinite(target.x) || !Number.isFinite(target.y)) return;
+  // Only the synergy accumulates rapid hits, independently for each enemy and damage source.
+  if(group&&hitType!=='miss') {
+    const existing=numbers.findLast(number=>number.target===target&&number.group===group&&!number.closed);
+    if(existing&&existing.hitType===hitType&&existing.sinceHit<=.3) {
+      existing.amount+=amount;existing.sinceHit=0;existing.elapsed=0;
+      Object.assign(existing,{scale:1},damageNumberStyle(existing.amount,player,existing.hitType));
+      existing.x=target.x;existing.y=target.y-(target.spriteSize||112)*.4;return;
+    }
+    // A changed hit type ends this run permanently; its popup continues its existing fade.
+    if(existing)existing.closed=true;
+  }
+  if (numbers.length >= damageNumberSettings.maxCount) numbers.shift();
+  numbers.push({ ...damageNumberStyle(amount, player, hitType), elapsed: 0,
+    x: target.x, y: target.y - (target.spriteSize || 112) * 0.4,
+    target,group,amount,hitType,closed:false,sinceHit:0,drift: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 24 });
+}
+
+/** Calculate the upward bounce, downward fall, and gradual end fade. */
+export function damageNumberPose(number) {
+  const t = number.elapsed;
+  const progress = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, t / damageNumberSettings.duration));
+  const fade = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (t - damageNumberSettings.fadeStart) /
+    (damageNumberSettings.duration - damageNumberSettings.fadeStart)));
+  return { x: number.x + number.drift * t,
+    y: number.y - 4 * damageNumberSettings.jumpHeight * progress * (1 - progress),
+    opacity: 1 - fade * fade };
+}
+
+/** Expire popups even when their targets die or leave the viewport. */
+export function updateDamageNumbers(delta) {
+  for (let i = numbers.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
+    numbers[i].elapsed += delta;
+    numbers[i].sinceHit += delta;
+    if (numbers[i].elapsed >= damageNumberSettings.duration) numbers.splice(i, 1);
+  }
+}
+
+/** Cache compact tinted bitmap numbers, preserving the font's dark outline. */
+function numberGraphic(text, color) {
+  const key = `${text}:${color}`;
+  if (textCache.has(key)) return textCache.get(key);
+  const glyphs = [...text].map(letter => fontMetrics[letter] || fontMetrics['?']);
+  const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
+  canvas.width = glyphs.reduce((sum, glyph) => sum + glyph.width - 1, 1);
+  canvas.height = 20;
+  const context = canvas.getContext('2d');
+  let x = 0;
+  for (const glyph of glyphs) {
+    context.drawImage(font, glyph.x, glyph.y, glyph.width, glyph.height,
+      x, glyph.offsetY, glyph.width, glyph.height);
+    x += glyph.width - 1;
+  }
+  if (color !== '#ffffff') {
+    const mask = document.createElement('canvas');
+    mask.width = canvas.width;
+    mask.height = canvas.height;
+    mask.getContext('2d').drawImage(canvas, 0, 0);
+    context.globalCompositeOperation = 'multiply';
+    context.fillStyle = color;
+    context.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
+    context.globalCompositeOperation = 'destination-in';
+    context.drawImage(mask, 0, 0);
+  }
+  if (textCache.size >= 128) textCache.delete(textCache.keys().next().value);
+  textCache.set(key, canvas);
+  return canvas;
+}
+
+/** Draw world-anchored numbers above actors, leaving the HUD unaffected. */
+export function drawDamageNumbers(context, camera, width, height) {
+  if (!font?.naturalWidth) return;
+  context.save();
+  context.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
+  for (const number of numbers) {
+    const pose = damageNumberPose(number);
+    const x = pose.x - camera.x, y = pose.y - camera.y;
+    if (x < -100 || y < -50 || x > width + 100 || y > height + 50) continue;
+    const graphic = numberGraphic(number.text, number.color);
+    context.save();
+    context.translate(x, y);
+    context.scale(number.scale ?? 1, number.scale ?? 1);
+    if (number.italic) context.transform(1, 0, -0.18, 1, 0, 0);
+    context.globalAlpha = pose.opacity;
+    context.drawImage(graphic, -graphic.width * 0.625, 0, graphic.width * 1.25, 25);
+    context.restore();
+  }
+  context.restore();
+}
