+/** Own a worker and route recognition results without blocking animation or uploading sketches. */
+export function createDrawingRecognizer() {
+  let worker, nextId = 0;
+  const pending = new Map();
+  function getWorker() {
+    if (!worker) {
+      worker = new Worker(new URL('./drawing-recognizer.worker.js', import.meta.url), { type: 'module' });
+      worker.addEventListener('message', ({ data }) => {
+        const job = pending.get(data.id);
+        if (!job) return;
+        pending.delete(data.id); clearTimeout(job.timeout);
+        if (data.error) job.reject(new Error(data.error)); else job.resolve(data.predictions || []);
+      });
+      worker.addEventListener('error', () => {
+        for (const job of pending.values()) { clearTimeout(job.timeout); job.reject(new Error('Drawing recognition could not start. Check your connection and retry.')); }
+        pending.clear(); worker.terminate(); worker = null;
+      });
+    }
+    return worker;
+  }
+  function request(type, image) {
+    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
+      const id = ++nextId;
+      try { const target = getWorker(); const timeout = setTimeout(() => { pending.delete(id); reject(new Error('Drawing recognition timed out. Please retry.')); }, 120000); pending.set(id, { resolve, reject, timeout }); target.postMessage({ id, type, image }); }
+      catch (error) { const job = pending.get(id); if (job) clearTimeout(job.timeout); pending.delete(id); reject(error); }
+    });
+  }
+  return {
+    warmup: () => request('warmup'),
+    recognize: image => request('classify', image),
+    recognizeSymbol: image => request('symbol', image),
+    dispose() {
+      worker?.terminate(); worker = null;
+      for (const job of pending.values()) { clearTimeout(job.timeout); job.reject(new Error('Recognition closed.')); }
+      pending.clear();
+    }
+  };
+}

+import { skillCastSettings } from './game-config.js';
+
+let classifier, clipClassifier, RawImage;
+/** Load the quantized QuickDraw classifier once, off the gameplay/UI thread. */
+async function loadClassifier() {
+  if (!classifier) {
+    classifier = (async () => {
+      const transformers = await import('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@huggingface/transformers@3.8.1');
+      const { pipeline, env } = transformers;
+      RawImage = transformers.RawImage;
+      env.allowLocalModels = false;
+      env.backends.onnx.wasm.numThreads = 1;
+      return pipeline('image-classification', skillCastSettings.model, { device: 'wasm', dtype: 'q8' });
+    })().catch(error => { classifier = null; throw error; });
+  }
+  return classifier;
+}
+
+/** Load CLIP lazily in the same worker; cache weights between casts. */
+async function loadClipClassifier() {
+  if (!clipClassifier) {
+    clipClassifier = (async () => {
+      const { pipeline, env } = await import('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@huggingface/transformers@3.8.1');
+      env.allowLocalModels = false;
+      env.backends.onnx.wasm.numThreads = 1;
+      return pipeline('zero-shot-image-classification', skillCastSettings.clipModel,
+        { device: 'wasm', dtype: 'q8' });
+    })().catch(error => { clipClassifier = null; throw error; });
+  }
+  return clipClassifier;
+}
+
+// Explicit alternatives prevent a single candidate from always receiving a perfect score.
+const symbolLabels = [
+  'a hand drawn circle enclosing an arrow above an X cross',
+  'a hand drawn empty circle',
+  'a hand drawn circle with only an arrow inside',
+  'a hand drawn circle with only an X inside',
+  'a hand drawn circle with an X above an arrow',
+  'random scribbles and unrelated shapes'
+];
+
+/** Receive normalized black-on-white PNGs and return ranked QuickDraw predictions. */
+self.addEventListener('message', async ({ data }) => {
+  try {
+    if (data.type === 'symbol') {
+      const pipe = await loadClipClassifier();
+      const predictions = await pipe(data.image, symbolLabels);
+      self.postMessage({ id: data.id, predictions });
+      return;
+    }
+    const pipe = await loadClassifier();
+    if (data.type === 'warmup') { self.postMessage({ id: data.id, ready: true }); return; }
+    // QuickDraw expects one channel; RGBA canvas PNGs must be explicitly converted.
+    const image = (await RawImage.read(data.image)).grayscale();
+    // QuickDraw bitmap training uses light strokes on a dark background.
+    for (let i = 0; i < image.data.length; i++) image.data[i] = 255 - image.data[i];
+    const predictions = await pipe(image, { top_k: 3 });
+    self.postMessage({ id: data.id, predictions });
+  } catch (error) {
+    self.postMessage({ id: data.id, error: error.message || 'Drawing recognition failed.' });
+  }
+});

+import { endlessEliteSettings, eliteChance, eliteChanceFormula } from './game-config.js';
+
+/** Own one repeatable endless elite buildup, followed by a forced boss wave. */
+export function createEndlessBuildup(onBossReady) {
+  let seconds = 0;
+  let ready = false;
+  return {
+    get phase() {
+      if (ready) return 'ready';
+      if (seconds < endlessEliteSettings.rampStartSeconds) return 'normal';
+      if (seconds < endlessEliteSettings.rampEndSeconds) return 'ramp';
+      return 'elites';
+    },
+    get seconds() { return seconds; },
+    // Admin shortcut starts the constant elite phase immediately.
+    startElites() { seconds = endlessEliteSettings.rampEndSeconds; ready = false; },
+    get eliteChance() { return ready ? eliteChance : eliteChanceFormula(seconds); },
+    spawnRate(normalRate) {
+      if (ready || seconds < endlessEliteSettings.rampStartSeconds) return normalRate;
+      const progress = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (seconds - endlessEliteSettings.rampStartSeconds) /
+        Math.max(1, endlessEliteSettings.rampEndSeconds - endlessEliteSettings.rampStartSeconds)));
+      return Math.round(normalRate + (endlessEliteSettings.maxSpawnRate - normalRate) * progress);
+    },
+    update(delta, { endless, bossAlive, spawning }) {
+      if (!endless || bossAlive) { seconds = 0; ready = false; return; }
+      if (!spawning || ready || !Number.isFinite(delta)) return;
+      seconds += Math.max(0, delta);
+      if (seconds >= endlessEliteSettings.rampEndSeconds + endlessEliteSettings.constantEliteSeconds) {
+        ready = true; // Restore ordinary arrivals before killing elites or requesting the boss.
+        onBossReady();
+      }
+    }
+  };
+}

+import { createEndlessBuildup } from './endless-buildup.js';
+import { endlessEventSettings, eliteChance, midoriSettings } from './game-config.js';
+
+export const endlessEventRegistry = {
+  eliteSurge: { name: 'Elite Surge', create: onComplete => createEndlessBuildup(onComplete) },
+  midori: { name: 'Midori Invasion' }
+};
+
+/** Manage elite surges and their boss-or-Midori outcome; admin triggers bypass campaign timing. */
+export function createEndlessEvents(onBossReady, random = Math.random, onMidoriStart = () => {}, onEventEnd = () => {}) {
+  let event = null, definition = null, bossWasAlive = false;
+  let midoriRemaining = 0, manual = false;
+  let eventKey = null, eventSequence = 0;
+  function endCurrent() {
+    if (eventKey) onEventEnd(eventKey);
+    eventKey = null;
+  }
+
+  /** Begin a Midori-only stream in place of requesting the boss wave. */
+  function startMidori() {
+    endCurrent();
+    eventKey = `midori-${++eventSequence}`;
+    midoriRemaining = midoriSettings.eventSeconds;
+    definition = endlessEventRegistry.midori;
+    onMidoriStart();
+  }
+  /** Resolve an elite army before choosing its replacement encounter. */
+  function finishElites() {
+    endCurrent();
+    if (random() < endlessEventSettings.midoriAfterEliteChance) startMidori();
+    else onBossReady();
+  }
+  function chooseEvent() {
+    endCurrent();
+    midoriRemaining = 0;
+    const ids = endlessEventSettings.enabledEvents.filter(id => endlessEventRegistry[id]?.create);
+    const id = ids[Math.floor(random() * ids.length)];
+    definition = endlessEventRegistry[id] || null;
+    event = definition ? definition.create(finishElites) : null;
+    eventKey = definition ? `eliteSurge-${++eventSequence}` : null;
+  }
+  chooseEvent();
+  return {
+    get name() { return definition?.name || 'None'; },
+    get phase() { return midoriRemaining > 0 ? 'midori' : event?.phase || 'normal'; },
+    get seconds() { return midoriRemaining > 0 ? midoriSettings.eventSeconds - midoriRemaining : event?.seconds || 0; },
+    get active() { return manual || midoriRemaining > 0; },
+    get eliteChance() { return midoriRemaining > 0 ? 0 : event?.eliteChance ?? eliteChance; },
+    get spawnEventKey() { return midoriRemaining > 0 || ['ramp', 'elites'].includes(event?.phase) ? eventKey : null; },
+    get spawnType() { return midoriRemaining > 0 ? 'midori' : null; },
+    get allowsBossWave() { return midoriRemaining <= 0 && (!event || event.phase === 'ready'); },
+    spawnRate(normalRate) { return midoriRemaining > 0 ? normalRate : event ? event.spawnRate(normalRate) : normalRate; },
+    /** Start either event immediately for testing without enabling endless progression. */
+    trigger(id) {
+      if (!['midori', 'eliteSurge'].includes(id)) return false;
+      manual = true;
+      if (id === 'midori') startMidori();
+      else if (id === 'eliteSurge') {
+        endCurrent();
+        eventKey = `eliteSurge-${++eventSequence}`;
+        midoriRemaining = 0;
+        definition = endlessEventRegistry.eliteSurge;
+        event = definition.create(finishElites);
+        event.startElites();
+      } else { manual = false; return false; }
+      return true;
+    },
+    stop() { manual = false; chooseEvent(); },
+    end() { manual = false; chooseEvent(); },
+    update(delta, state) {
+      if (bossWasAlive && !state.bossAlive) { manual = false; chooseEvent(); }
+      bossWasAlive = state.bossAlive;
+      if (midoriRemaining > 0) {
+        if (state.bossAlive) { manual = false; chooseEvent(); return; }
+        if (state.spawning && Number.isFinite(delta)) midoriRemaining -= Math.max(0, delta);
+        if (midoriRemaining <= 0) { manual = false; chooseEvent(); }
+        return;
+      }
+      event?.update(delta, { ...state, endless: state.endless || manual });
+    }
+  };
+}

+import { beginKnockback, advanceKnockback } from './knockback.js';
+
+/** Stun independently of displacement, respecting knockback resistance and absolute immunity. */
+export function applySkillControl(enemy, dx, dy, stunSeconds, travelSeconds, options = {}) {
+  enemy.stunRemaining = Math.max(enemy.stunRemaining || 0, stunSeconds);
+  enemy.skillKnockback = beginKnockback(enemy, dx, dy, travelSeconds, options);
+  enemy.contactReaction = null; enemy.attack = null; enemy.moving = false;
+}
+
+/** Resolve stun before AI/contact so a stunned enemy cannot move or damage the player. */
+export function updateEnemyControl(enemy, delta, move) {
+  const stunned = enemy.stunRemaining > 0;
+  if (!stunned && !enemy.skillKnockback) return false;
+  enemy.stunRemaining = Math.max(0, (enemy.stunRemaining || 0) - delta);
+  if (enemy.stunRemaining < 1e-6) enemy.stunRemaining = 0;
+  const knockback = enemy.skillKnockback;
+  if (knockback) {
+    if (!advanceKnockback(enemy, knockback, delta, move)) delete enemy.skillKnockback;
+  }
+  if (stunned) enemy.moving = false;
+  return stunned;
+}

+/** Visual hop only: collision and world positions stay grounded while Pedrozilla skips. */
+export function enemyBounceOffset(character) {

+import { basicMobHpFormula, eliteChanceFormula } from './game-config.js';
+import { standardEnemyWeights, enemyStagePools, enemyTypeStats, playerSettings, enemyStatsScalingFormula, campaignScalingTimeFormula } from './game-config.js';

+// Elite size, HP and spawn chance are configured in game-config.js.
+

+/** Roll basic-enemy elites; bosses and playable-character test NPCs are excluded. */
+export function enemyVariant(type, template, mode = 'random', random = Math.random, survivalSeconds = 0, endlessSeconds = null, eliteProbability = eliteChanceFormula(endlessSeconds)) {
+  const elite = template.miniBoss === true || type === 'midori' || (type === 'mob' || template.standard) && (mode === 'elite' || (mode === 'random' && random() < eliteProbability));
+  const baseHp = (['mob', 'midori'].includes(type) || template.standard) ? basicMobHpFormula(survivalSeconds)
+    : type === 'shiroko' ? mobBaseHp * shirokoBossStats.hpMultiplier : combatBalance.otherEnemyHp;
+  const megaType = type === 'megaMob' || (type === 'mob' && elite) ? 'megaMob' :
+    type === 'megaSweeper' || (['whiteSweeper','heavySweeper'].includes(type) && elite) ? 'megaSweeper' : null;
+  const dedicatedMega = Boolean(megaType);
+  const profile = enemyTypeStats[megaType || type];
+  const scaled = profile ? enemyStatsScalingFormula(profile, campaignScalingTimeFormula(endlessSeconds)) : null;
+  const maxHp = (scaled?.hp ?? baseHp) * (elite && !dedicatedMega ? combatBalance.eliteHpMultiplier : 1);
+  return {
+    elite,
+    miniBoss: template.miniBoss === true || (elite && type !== 'midori'),
+    label: dedicatedMega ? (megaType === 'megaSweeper' ? 'Mega Sweeper' : 'Mega Mob') : elite && type !== 'midori' ? `Mega ${template.label}` : template.label,
+    spriteSize: (template.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize) * (elite && type !== 'midori' && !template.miniBoss ? (template.megaSizeMultiplier ?? eliteSizeMultiplier) : 1),
+    hp: maxHp,
+    maxHp,
+    contactDamage: type === 'shiroko' ? shirokoBossStats.contactDamage : template.contactDamage,
+    contactDamageMultiplier: elite && !dedicatedMega ? 2 : 1,
+    ...(profile ? { hp: Math.round(maxHp), maxHp: Math.round(maxHp), perTypeStats: true,
+      contactDamage: scaled.atk, expReward: profile.expValue,
+      movementSpeedMultiplier: scaled.spd * playerSettings.speed / playerSettings.movementBase } : {})
+  };
+}
+
+/** Pick from the configured standard enemy pool while keeping Mob most common. */
+export function chooseStandardEnemy(random = Math.random, elapsedSeconds = 0, stageId = null) {
+  const weights = stageId && enemyStagePools[stageId] ? Object.fromEntries(enemyStagePools[stageId].map(type=>[type,1])) : standardEnemyWeights;
+  const entries = Object.entries(weights).filter(([type, weight]) => {
+    const profile = enemyTypeStats[type];
+    return weight > 0 && (!profile || (elapsedSeconds >= profile.spawnStartSeconds && elapsedSeconds < profile.spawnEndSeconds));
+  });
+  let roll = random() * entries.reduce((sum, [, weight]) => sum + weight, 0);
+  for (const [type, weight] of entries) { roll -= weight; if (roll < 0) return type; }
+  return entries.at(-1)?.[0] ?? null;
+}

+/** Find walkable ground near the intended landing, even if an enemy died inside an obstacle. */
+export function safeDropLanding(x, y) {
+  if (isLandingClear(x, y, lootLandingRadius)) return { x, y };
+  for (let radius = 24; radius <= 2048; radius += 24) {
+    const samples = Math.min(64, Math.ceil(radius / 12) * 8);
+    for (let index = 0; index < samples; index++) {
+      const angle = index / samples * Math.PI * 2;
+      const px = x + Math.cos(angle) * radius, py = y + Math.sin(angle) * radius;
+      if (isLandingClear(px, py, lootLandingRadius)) return { x: px, y: py };
+    }
+  }
+  return null;
+}
+
+/** Redirect a scatter to safe ground; retain unplaceable loot for a later retry. */
+export function constrainDropLanding(drop) {
+  const flight = drop.scatter;
+  const landing = safeDropLanding(flight.x + flight.dx, flight.y + flight.dy);
+  drop.pendingLanding = !landing;
+  if (landing) {
+    flight.dx = landing.x - flight.x;
+    flight.dy = landing.y - flight.y;
+  }
+}
+
+/** Launch loot toward a random nearby landing spot with a small airborne hop. */
+export function launchDrop(drop, random = Math.random) {
+  const angle = random() * Math.PI * 2;
+  const distance = dropScatter.minDistance + random() * (dropScatter.maxDistance - dropScatter.minDistance);
+  drop.scatter = { elapsed: 0, x: drop.x, y: drop.y,
+    dx: Math.cos(angle) * distance, dy: Math.sin(angle) * distance,
+    rotation: drop.rotation, spin: (random() - 0.5) * Math.PI };
+  constrainDropLanding(drop);
+  return drop;
+}
+
+/** Animate the outward toss before enabling pickup attraction or collection. */
+export function updateDropScatter(drop, delta) {
+  if (!drop.scatter) return false;
+  if (drop.pendingLanding) {
+    drop.landingRetry = (drop.landingRetry || 0) - delta;
+    if (drop.landingRetry <= 0) { constrainDropLanding(drop); drop.landingRetry = 0.5; }
+    if (drop.pendingLanding) return true;
+  }
+  const flight = drop.scatter;
+  flight.elapsed += Math.max(0, delta);
+  const t = Math.min(1, flight.elapsed / dropScatter.duration);
+  const progress = 1 - (1 - t) ** 2;
+  drop.x = flight.x + flight.dx * progress;
+  drop.y = flight.y + flight.dy * progress;
+  drop.lift = 4 * dropScatter.hopHeight * t * (1 - t);
+  drop.rotation = flight.rotation + flight.spin * progress;
+  if (t === 1) { delete drop.scatter; drop.lift = 0; }
+  return true;
+}

+/** Burst Yuuka credits throughout a disk, with angular coverage in every direction. */
+export function dropYuukaCredits(enemy, defeated = false, random = Math.random) {
+  const count = defeated ? yuukaSettings.deathCredits : yuukaSettings.hitCredits;
+  const radius = bossExpRewards.maxDistance * yuukaSettings.burstRadiusMultiplier;
+  const angleOffset = random() * Math.PI * 2;
+  const rewards = [];
+  for (let index = 0; index < count; index++) {
+    const drop = { id: ++nextId, kind: 'credits', value: 1, x: enemy.x,
+      y: enemy.y + (enemy.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize) / 2 - spriteDisplayPadding,
+      rotation: random() * Math.PI * 2 };
+    drops.set(drop.id, drop);
+    launchDrop(drop, random);
+    if (defeated) {
+      const angle = angleOffset + (index + random()) / count * Math.PI * 2;
+      // Square root distributes credits by area, throughout the whole radius.
+      const distance = Math.sqrt(random()) * radius;
+      drop.scatter.dx = Math.cos(angle) * distance;
+      drop.scatter.dy = Math.sin(angle) * distance;
+      constrainDropLanding(drop);
+    }
+    rewards.push(drop);
+  }
+  return rewards;
+}

+/** Roll a report's EXP value: elites get Report 1 (80%) or Report 2 (20%). */
+export function rollEnemyExp(random = Math.random, elite = false) {

+    return random() < reportSettings.eliteSecondChance
+      ? reportSettings.secondMin + Math.floor(random() * (reportSettings.secondMax - reportSettings.secondMin + 1))

+  }
+  const uncommon = random() >= reportSettings.commonChance;
+  return uncommon ? reportSettings.secondMin + Math.floor(random() * (reportSettings.secondMax - reportSettings.secondMin + 1))

+/** Scale elite rewards down, cap their combined EXP, and preserve positive report pickups. */
+export function rollEliteReports(random = Math.random, override, player = getActivePlayer()) {
+  const values = Array.from({ length: eliteExpRewards.count }, () =>
+    Math.max(reportSettings.secondMin, Math.floor(override ?? rollEnemyExp(random, true))));
+  let deficit = eliteExpRewards.minimumTotal - values.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0);
+  const indices = values.map((_, index) => index).sort((a, b) => values[b] - values[a]);
+  for (const index of indices) {
+    if (deficit <= 0) break;
+    const extra = Math.min(deficit, Math.max(0, reportSettings.thirdMax - values[index]));
+    values[index] += extra;
+    deficit -= extra;
+  }
+  const rolledTotal = values.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0);
+  const total = eliteExpTotalFormula(rolledTotal, player?.level || 1);
+  const count = Math.min(values.length, total);
+  if (!count) return [];
+  // Give every report one point, then share the remainder by its original roll weight.
+  const weights = values.slice(0, count);
+  const weightTotal = weights.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0);
+  const rewards = weights.map(weight => 1 + Math.floor((total - count) * weight / weightTotal));
+  let remaining = total - rewards.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0);
+  for (let index = 0; remaining > 0; index = (index + 1) % count, remaining--) rewards[index]++;
+  return rewards;
+}

+/** Split a level-scaled boss reward into positive reports without losing EXP. */
+export function rollBossReports(player, random = Math.random, fixedTotal) {
+  if (Number.isFinite(fixedTotal) && fixedTotal > 0) {
+    const total = Math.round(fixedTotal);
+    const count = Math.min(total, Math.max(bossExpRewards.minimumReports, Math.ceil(total/reportSettings.thirdMax)));
+    return Array.from({length:count}, (_,i)=>Math.floor(total/count)+(i<total%count?1:0));
+  }
+  const requirement = experienceForLevel(player?.level || 1);
+  const minimum = Math.max(bossExpRewards.minimumReports,
+    Math.ceil(requirement * bossExpRewards.minLevels));
+  const maximum = Math.max(minimum, Math.floor(requirement * bossExpRewards.maxLevels));
+  const total = minimum + Math.floor(random() * (maximum - minimum + 1));
+  const count = Math.max(bossExpRewards.minimumReports, Math.ceil(total / reportSettings.thirdMax));
+  const base = Math.floor(total / count), remainder = total % count;
+  return Array.from({ length: count }, (_, index) => base + (index < remainder ? 1 : 0));
+}

diff --git a/Development/firing-rings.js b/Development/firing-rings.js
new file mode 100644

+++ b/Development/firing-rings.js
@@ -0,0 +1,25 @@
+/** Common growth keeps the outer rings strictly larger despite their staggered appearances. */
+export function firingRingPoses(elapsed,size) {
+  const growth=1+Math.min(1,Math.max(0,elapsed)/.5)*1.5;
+  return Array.from({length:3},(_,i)=>{
+    const age=elapsed-i*.045,t=age/.42;
+    return {visible:age>=0&&t<1,x:i*22+Math.max(0,elapsed)*55,
+      radius:size*(.65+i*.5)*growth,opacity:Math.max(0,1-t)**2*.75};
+  });
+}
+
+/** Soft double-stroked muzzle shock rings; local impact only, no screen flash. */
+export function drawFiringRings(context,x,y,angle,elapsed,size,blue=false) {
+  const rings=firingRingPoses(elapsed,size);if(!rings.some(r=>r.visible))return;
+  context.save();context.translate(x,y);context.rotate(angle);context.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';context.shadowBlur=0;
+  for(const ring of rings) {
+    if(!ring.visible)continue;context.globalAlpha=ring.opacity;context.beginPath();
+    for(let point=0;point<=32;point++) {
+      const a=point/32*Math.PI*2,px=ring.x+Math.cos(a)*ring.radius*.3,py=Math.sin(a)*ring.radius;
+      if(point===0)context.moveTo(px,py);else context.lineTo(px,py);
+    }
+    context.strokeStyle=blue?'rgba(75,190,255,.4)':'rgba(255,100,220,.4)';context.lineWidth=6;context.stroke();
+    context.strokeStyle=blue?'#e5fcff':'#ffe9fc';context.lineWidth=1.6;context.stroke();
+  }
+  context.restore();
+}

+/** Center the reference 1280x720 game area in a dark surround, preserving the session. */
+export function setupFullscreenPreview(canvas, releaseControls) {
+  const enter = document.querySelector('#enter-fullscreen-preview');
+  const exit = document.querySelector('#exit-fullscreen-preview');
+  const layout = document.querySelector('.playtest-layout');
+  const main = document.querySelector('#development-content');
+  const sidebar = document.querySelector('.playtest-sidebar');
+  let active = false;
+  let previousInert = [];
+
+  /** Resize via CSS/ResizeObserver; never scale actors or reset world positions. */
+  function setFullscreen(enabled) {
+    if (active === enabled) return;
+    active = enabled;
+    releaseControls();
+    document.body.classList.toggle('fullscreen-preview', active);
+    enter.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(active));
+    exit.hidden = !active;
+    if (active) {
+      // Background admin controls should not receive hidden keyboard focus.
+      const controls = [...main.children].filter(element => element !== layout).concat(sidebar);
+      previousInert = controls.map(element => [element, element.inert]);
+      for (const [element] of previousInert) element.inert = true;
+      canvas.focus({ preventScroll: true });
+    } else {
+      for (const [element, inert] of previousInert) element.inert = inert;
+      previousInert = [];
+      enter.focus({ preventScroll: true });
+    }
+  }
+
+  enter.addEventListener('click', () => setFullscreen(true));
+  exit.addEventListener('click', () => setFullscreen(false));
+}

+import { rollLevelUpgrades } from './level-upgrades.js';
+import { recordWeaponMax } from './weapon-max-order.js';
+
+// Add actual super items here when their effects are defined. Empty pools fall back to normal Files.
+export const superFileItems=[];
+export const fileSettings={superChance:.05,tripleChance:.09,newChance:.1,weaponChance:.7,
+  dropChance:0,bossGuaranteed:true,icon:'../sprites/icons/3 Stars Character Icon.png',maxGround:20,
+  creditReplacementPerMax:.05,creditReplacementCap:.6};
+
+/** Inclusive integer rolls and the supplied nested-floor Credits formula. */
+export function fileCredits(type,random=Math.random,moneyUpBonus=0,stageMultiplier=1) {
+  const [a,b]=type==='super'?[399,5]:type==='triple'?[399,3]:[301,1];
+  const integer=max=>Math.min(max,Math.floor(random()*(max+1)));
+  const multiplier=(1+moneyUpBonus/100)*stageMultiplier;
+  return Math.floor(Math.floor(a/(3+integer(2)))*multiplier*(1+b*(20+integer(10))/100*multiplier));
+}
+
+/** Apply one accepted product without spending level-up choices; dropping never applies it. */
+export function acceptFileProduct(player,product) {
+  const slots=product.kind==='item'?(player.equipmentSlots??=[]):(player.attackSlots??=[]);
+  const owned=slots.find(item=>item?.id===product.weapon.id);
+  if(owned) {
+    if(owned.isSynergy)return false;
+    const max=owned.maxLevel||7;if((owned.level||1)>=max)return false;
+    owned.level=(owned.level||1)+1;if(product.kind!=='item')recordWeaponMax(player,owned);return true;
+  }
+  const index=slots.findIndex(item=>!item);
+  if(index<0&&slots.filter(Boolean).length>=6)return false;
+  const item={...product.weapon};if(index>=0)slots[index]=item;else slots.push(item);return true;
+}
+
+/** Generate products using a shadow inventory so triple rewards cannot overfill or overlevel it. */
+export function rollFileRewards(player,{random=Math.random,forceType,getOptions=rollLevelUpgrades,superItems=superFileItems}={}) {
+  const roll=random();let type=forceType||(roll<fileSettings.superChance?'super':roll<fileSettings.superChance+fileSettings.tripleChance?'triple':'normal');
+  const supers=superItems.filter(item=>!player.equipmentSlots?.some(owned=>owned?.id===item.id)&&
+    (player.equipmentSlots||[]).filter(Boolean).length<6);
+  if(type==='super'&&!supers.length)type='normal';
+  const result={type,products:[],credits:fileCredits(type,random,player.moneyUpBonus||0,player.stageCoinMultiplier??1)};
+  if(type==='super') {
+    const item=supers[Math.min(supers.length-1,Math.floor(random()*supers.length))];
+    result.products.push({kind:'item',weapon:{...item,level:1},name:item.name,super:true});return result;
+  }
+  const shadow={...player,attackSlots:(player.attackSlots||[]).map(w=>w?{...w}:null),equipmentSlots:(player.equipmentSlots||[]).map(w=>w?{...w}:null)};
+  const free={weapon:6-shadow.attackSlots.filter(Boolean).length,item:6-shadow.equipmentSlots.filter(Boolean).length};
+  for(let index=0;index<(type==='triple'?3:1);index++) {
+    const maxed=[...shadow.attackSlots,...shadow.equipmentSlots].filter(w=>w&&(w.isSynergy||(w.level||1)>=(w.maxLevel||7))).length;
+    // Editable saturation behavior: each MAX slot adds 5 percentage points toward the 100-Credit substitution.
+    if(random()<Math.min(fileSettings.creditReplacementCap,maxed*fileSettings.creditReplacementPerMax)){result.credits+=100;continue;}
+    const options=getOptions(shadow).filter(choice=>choice.weapon&&!choice.weapon.isSynergy);
+    let selected=null;
+    const allowNew=random()<fileSettings.newChance;
+    for(let attempt=0;attempt<5&&!selected;attempt++) {
+      let kind=random()<fileSettings.weaponChance?'weapon':'item';
+      const pool=k=>options.filter(option=>{
+        const category=/item|equipment/i.test(option.category||'')?'item':'weapon';
+        const owned=(k==='item'?shadow.equipmentSlots:shadow.attackSlots).some(w=>w?.id===option.weapon.id);
+        return category===k&&(owned||(allowNew&&free[k]>index));
+      });
+      let candidates=pool(kind);if(!candidates.length&&kind==='weapon'){kind='item';candidates=pool(kind);}
+      if(candidates.length){const choice=candidates[Math.min(candidates.length-1,Math.floor(random()*candidates.length))];selected={...choice,kind};}
+    }
+    if(selected&&acceptFileProduct(shadow,selected))result.products.push(selected);else result.credits+=100;
+  }
+  return result;
+}

+/** Keep normal odds until 5 endless minutes, then linearly reach all elites at 10. */
+export function eliteChanceFormula(endlessSeconds = null) {
+  if (endlessSeconds === null) return eliteChance;
+  const s = endlessEliteSettings;
+  const progress = Math.max(0, Math.min(1,
+    (endlessSeconds - s.rampStartSeconds) / Math.max(1, s.rampEndSeconds - s.rampStartSeconds)));
+  return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, eliteChance + (s.targetChance - eliteChance) * progress));
+}

+export const survivalTimerSettings = { fontScale: 1.25, offsetBelowExp: 8 };

+/** Basic Mob HP: 60 + (350-60) * (survivalSeconds/900)^1, rounded. */
+export function basicMobHpFormula(seconds) {
+  const progress = Math.max(0, seconds) / mobHealthScaling.targetSeconds;
+  return Math.max(1, Math.round(mobBaseHp + (mobHealthScaling.targetHp - mobBaseHp) *
+    progress ** mobHealthScaling.exponent));
+}

+/** Chance after unlock/cooldown: .25%, plus .5 percentage points per pity step, capped at 2.5%. */
+export function yuukaSpawnChanceFormula(kills, hasSpawned = false, bossActive = false) {
+  const settings = yuukaSpawnSettings;
+  if (kills < settings.unlockKills || (hasSpawned && kills < settings.cooldownKills)) return 0;
+  const steps = Math.floor(Math.max(0, kills - settings.pityStart) / settings.pityStepKills);
+  return Math.min(settings.maxChance, settings.baseChance + steps * settings.pityStepChance) *
+    (bossActive ? specialEnemySettings.bossSpawnMultiplier : 1);
+}

+/** floor(enemyBase * variantMultiplier * (1 + (level/6) * (minutes/4))). */
+export function enemyContactDamageFormula(baseDamage, level, survivalSeconds, variantMultiplier = 1) {
+  const s = enemyDamageScaling;
+  const minutes = Math.max(0, survivalSeconds) / 60;
+  const scale = s.base + (Math.max(1, level) / s.levelDivisor) * (minutes / s.minutesDivisor);
+  return Math.max(0, Math.floor(baseDamage * variantMultiplier * scale));
+}

+/** Nearest integer with ties to even, used by the EXP curve. */
+export function roundToEven(value) {
+  const lower = Math.floor(value), fraction = value - lower;
+  return fraction === 0.5 ? lower + (lower % 2) : Math.round(value);
+}
+export function levelExpFormula(level) {
+  const current = Math.max(1, Math.floor(level));
+  return current === 1 ? 79 : roundToEven((4 * (current + 1)) ** 2.1) - roundToEven((4 * current) ** 2.1);
+}
+
+/** Standard Mob report: round(3 + playerLevel / (2 + reportTier)). */
+export function mobExpFormula(level, tier) {
+  return Math.round(reportSettings.mobBase + Math.max(1, Math.floor(level)) /
+    (reportSettings.mobDivisor + Math.max(0, Math.min(3, Math.floor(tier)))));
+}
+
+/** Yuuka spawn HP: round((normal player damage + 100) / 100 * 900). */
+export const yuukaHpSettings = { offset: 100, divisor: 100, base: 900 };
+export function yuukaHpFormula(damage) {
+  return Math.max(1, Math.round((Math.max(0, damage) + yuukaHpSettings.offset) /
+    yuukaHpSettings.divisor * yuukaHpSettings.base));
+}
+
+/** ATK/SPD/PICKUP/Haste percent bonus multiplier (25% -> 1.25). */
+export function percentBonusFormula(percent) {
+  return 1 + Math.max(0, Number.isFinite(Number(percent)) ? Number(percent) : 0) / 100;
+}

+/** Crowd-adjusted arrivals: 8/s empty -> 5/s at40 nearby; 2/s at50 visible slots. */
+export function spawnRateFormula(nearby, visible) {
+  const s = playtestSpawnSettings;
+  if (visible >= s.visibleLimit) return s.crowdedPerSecond;
+  return Math.round(s.perSecond + (s.maxPerSecond - s.perSecond) *
+    (1 - Math.min(1, nearby / s.nearbyTarget)));
+}
+
+/** Boss chance per eligible kill; charge freezes while any boss is alive. */
+export function bossPityThresholds(endlessSeconds = null) {
+  const s = bossSpawnSettings;
+  return endlessSeconds !== null && endlessSeconds >= s.lateEndlessSeconds
+    ? { unlockKills: s.lateUnlockKills, pityStart: s.latePityStart, guaranteedKills: s.lateGuaranteedKills }
+    : { unlockKills: s.unlockKills, pityStart: s.pityStart, guaranteedKills: s.guaranteedKills };
+}
+
+/** Select the live pity curve using time since completing Stage 4, keeping the existing kill counter. */
+export function bossChanceFormula(kills, endlessSeconds = null) {
+  const s = { ...bossSpawnSettings, ...bossPityThresholds(endlessSeconds) };
+  if (kills < s.unlockKills) return 0;
+  const pity = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (kills - s.pityStart) / (s.guaranteedKills - s.pityStart)));
+  return s.baseChance + (1 - s.baseChance) * pity;
+}

+/** Growth is inactive until purchased; costs are reserved for the future upgrade shop. */

+  const rank = Math.max(0, Math.min(growthSettings.maxRank, Math.floor(growthRank)));
+  const tickMultiplier = Math.min(1, Math.max(growthSettings.minimumTickMultiplier,
+    hitCooldownFrames / growthSettings.tickThresholdFrames));
+  const growth = growthEligible ? growthSettings.damagePerLevelPerRank / damageRules.baseScale *
+    rank * Math.max(1, playerLevel) / Math.max(1, projectileCount) * tickMultiplier : 0;
+  // Enhancements add flat damage after level/enchantment bonuses, split over primary projectiles.
+  const enhancement=Math.max(0,Math.floor(enhancementRank))*crafterSettings.enhancementDamagePerRank/damageRules.baseScale/Math.max(1,projectileCount);
+  return weapon + growth + enhancement;
+}
+
+
+/** Haste changes start-to-start timing only; quantize to60Hz frames, minimum one frame. */
+export function attackTimeFormula(baseSeconds, hastePercent = 0, minimumFrames = 1) {
+  return Math.max(1, minimumFrames, Math.round(baseSeconds * 60 /
+    (1 + Math.max(0, hastePercent) / 100))) / 60;
+}
+
+/** Standard base40px; characters may override their starting radius (including zero). */
+export function pickupRangeFormula(bonusPercent = 0, baseRadius = 40) {
+  return Math.max(0, baseRadius + 0.4 * bonusPercent);
+}
+
+
+/** ATK values are percentage points: base100 + bonuses20+30 = total150%. */
+export const attackStatSettings = { baseATK: 100 };
+export function totalATKFormula(baseATK = attackStatSettings.baseATK, bonuses = []) {
+  return baseATK + bonuses.reduce((sum, bonus) => sum + bonus, 0);
+}
+
+
+/** Critical modifier is bonus percentage points: +50% means1.5x total damage. */
+export function totalCritModFormula(baseCritMod = (combatBalance.criticalMultiplier - 1) * 100, bonuses = []) {
+  return baseCritMod + bonuses.reduce((sum, bonus) => sum + bonus, 0);
+}
+
+
+/** Target vulnerability debuffs add percentage points, then multiply final damage. */
+export function bonusDamageTakenFormula(bonuses = []) {
+  return 1 + bonuses.reduce((sum, bonus) => sum + bonus, 0) / 100;
+}
+
+
+/** Damage Bonus sources use multipliers:1.2x and1.3x stack to1.5x. */
+export function damageBonusFormula(bonuses = []) {
+  return 1 + bonuses.reduce((sum, bonus) => sum + (bonus - 1), 0);
+}
+
+
+/** Independent target reductions multiply; values are percentage points (20 =20%). */
+export function damageReductionFormula(reductions = []) {
+  return reductions.reduce((multiplier, reduction) =>
+    multiplier * (1 - Math.max(0, Math.min(100, reduction)) / 100), 1);
+}
+
+
+/** Halo item: threshold is inclusive for the far bonus; level0 means unequipped. */
+export const haloSettings = { distanceThreshold: 130, closeMultiplier: 0.9,
+  farMultipliers: [1.2, 1.4, 1.6] };
+export function haloDamageFormula(distance, level = 0) {
+  const rank = Math.max(0, Math.min(haloSettings.farMultipliers.length, Math.floor(level)));
+  if (!rank) return 1;
+  return distance < haloSettings.distanceThreshold ? haloSettings.closeMultiplier :
+    haloSettings.farMultipliers[rank - 1];
+}
+
+
+/** Combine independent modifier categories; each category aggregates its own sources first. */
+export function damageModifiersFormula({ criticalMultiplier = 1, bonusDamageTaken = 1,
+  DB = 1, DR = 1, halo = 1, attackModifier = 1 } = {}) {
+  return criticalMultiplier * bonusDamageTaken * DB * DR * halo * attackModifier;
+}
+
+
+/** Special-enemy stats are snapshots at spawn, using timer components, not total minutes.
+ * SPD is a ratio of unmodified playerSettings.speed; callers convert it to movement units.
+ * These profiles are opt-in pending enemy assignments and attack implementation.
+ */
+export function specialEnemyStatsFormula(type, elapsedSeconds = 0) {
+  const seconds = Math.max(0, Math.floor(elapsedSeconds));
+  const minuteTimer = Math.floor(seconds / 60) % 60;
+  const secondTimer = seconds % 60;
+  if (type === 'bomber-boss') {
+    return {
+      atk: 2 + 0.225 * minuteTimer,
+      spd: 0.42 + 0.018 * minuteTimer,
+      hp: Math.round(1000 + 1000 ** (1 + minuteTimer / 25)),
+      expValue: Math.round(750 ** (1 + minuteTimer / 60)),
+      instantKOImmune: true
+    };
+  }
+  if (type !== 'shooter' && type !== 'bomber') {
+    throw new RangeError('Special stat profile must be shooter, bomber or bomber-boss.');
+  }
+  return {
+    atk: 2 + minuteTimer * (type === 'shooter' ? 0.8 : 0.15),
+    spd: 0.35 + 0.015 * minuteTimer,
+    hp: Math.round(4 ** (3.6 + minuteTimer / 8.5) - 127),
+    expValue: Math.round(5 ** (1 + (minuteTimer + secondTimer / 30) / 25))
+  };
+}
+
+
+/** Reference time scaling uses full elapsed minute/hour components. */
+export function enemyTimeScalingFormula(elapsedSeconds = 0) {
+  const seconds = Math.max(0, elapsedSeconds);
+  const fullMinutes = Math.floor(seconds / 60);
+  const minuteTimer = fullMinutes % 60;
+  const hourTimer = Math.floor(seconds / 3600);
+  const minutesPast30 = Math.max(0, fullMinutes - 30);
+  const hourPast1 = Math.max(0, hourTimer - 1);
+  return { a: Math.max(0, minuteTimer - 23) + 37 * hourTimer,
+    b: minutesPast30 + 60 * hourPast1 };
+}
+
+/** Minute-quantized reference stats; rounding HP/ATK is left to damage/entity consumers. */
+export function enemyStatsScalingFormula({ baseATK, baseSPD, baseHP }, elapsedSeconds = 0) {
+  const { a, b } = enemyTimeScalingFormula(elapsedSeconds);
+  return {
+    atk: (baseATK + 2 * a) ** (1 + b / 25),
+    spd: Math.min(300, (baseSPD + 0.12 * a) ** (1 + b / 25)),
+    hp: (baseHP + baseHP * 0.05 * a) ** (1 + b / 50)
+  };
+}
+
+/** Optional project clock: campaign stays unscaled; endless starts at reference23:00.
+ * Supply active seconds since Stage4 completion, or null before endless.
+ * Reference a first increases one full minute later; no enemy-pool swap is implied.
+ */
+export function campaignScalingTimeFormula(endlessSeconds = null) {
+  return endlessSeconds === null ? 0 : 23 * 60 + Math.max(0, endlessSeconds);
+}

+/** Final score weights; boss/miniboss bonuses supplement the overall enemy defeat count. */
+export const scoreSettings = {
+  enemy: 75, miniBoss: 428, boss: 2251, minutePast30: 20126,
+  minute: 126, second: 10, level: 1219,
+  hardcoreMinute: 0.01, hardcoreHour: 1.2
+};
+
+/** Calculate a score snapshot with timer components, preserving the supplied hour rules.
+ * Hardcore is opt-in; this helper does not implement a Hardcore game mode or publish scores.
+ */
+export function scoreFormula({ enemyDefeated = 0, miniBossDefeated = 0, bossDefeated = 0,
+  playerLevel = 1, elapsedSeconds = 0, hardcore = false } = {}) {
+  const seconds = Math.max(0, Math.floor(elapsedSeconds));
+  const finalHourValue = Math.floor(seconds / 3600);
+  const finalMinuteValue = Math.floor(seconds / 60) % 60;
+  const finalSecondValue = seconds % 60;
+  const s = scoreSettings;
+  const baseScore = enemyDefeated * s.enemy + miniBossDefeated * s.miniBoss + bossDefeated * s.boss +
+    Math.max(0, finalMinuteValue - 30) * s.minutePast30 + Math.min(59, finalMinuteValue) * s.minute +
+    Math.min(59, finalSecondValue) * s.second + playerLevel * s.level;
+  const hardcoreBonus = hardcore ? Math.floor(baseScore *
+    (finalMinuteValue * s.hardcoreMinute + finalHourValue * s.hardcoreHour)) : 0;
+  return { baseScore, hardcoreBonus, finalScore: Math.floor(baseScore + hardcoreBonus) };
+}

+import { synergyRecipes } from './synergy-recipes.js';
+import { umbrellaUpgradeSettings, arisWeaponSettings } from './game-config.js';
+
+/** Use each weapon's actual MAX level, including future weapon definitions. */
+function maximumLevel(weapon) {
+  return weapon.id==='plana-umbrella'?umbrellaUpgradeSettings.maxLevel:
+    weapon.id==='aris-laser'?arisWeaponSettings.maxLevel:weapon.maxLevel;
+}
+
+/** Only compatible, equipped MAX pairs can cause a Golden Crafter drop or fusion choice. */
+export function goldenCrafterChoices(player,recipes=synergyRecipes) {
+  const slots=player.attackSlots||[],choices=[];
+  for(const recipe of recipes) {
+    if(!recipe.id||!recipe.result?.id||recipe.ingredients?.length!==2||slots.some(w=>w?.id===recipe.result.id))continue;
+    for(let a=0;a<Math.min(6,slots.length);a++)for(let b=a+1;b<Math.min(6,slots.length);b++) {
+      const first=slots[a],second=slots[b];if(!first||!second)continue;
+      const ids=[first.id,second.id].sort(),needed=[...recipe.ingredients].sort();
+      if(ids[0]!==needed[0]||ids[1]!==needed[1])continue;
+      if(!Number.isFinite(maximumLevel(first))||!Number.isFinite(maximumLevel(second))||
+        (first.level||1)<maximumLevel(first)||(second.level||1)<maximumLevel(second))continue;
+      choices.push({id:`synergy:${recipe.id}:${a}:${b}`,name:recipe.result.name||recipe.result.id,
+        label:'Fuse MAX weapons',kind:'synergy',target:recipe.result,recipe,slots:[a,b],disabled:false,
+        description:recipe.description||`Fuse ${first.name||first.id} and ${second.name||second.id} into ${recipe.result.name||recipe.result.id}.`});
+    }
+  }
+  return choices;
+}
+
+/** Replace the two ingredients with one synergy atomically; cancellation never calls this. */
+export function applyGoldenCrafterChoice(player,id,recipes=synergyRecipes) {
+  const choice=goldenCrafterChoices(player,recipes).find(choice=>choice.id===id);
+  if(!choice)return {consumed:false,success:false,message:'No compatible MAX-level weapon pair.'};
+  let result;
+  try{result=choice.recipe.createWeapon?choice.recipe.createWeapon():{...choice.recipe.result};}
+  catch{return {consumed:false,success:false,message:'Fusion unavailable. The Golden Crafter was not used.'};}
+  if(!result||result.id!==choice.recipe.result.id)return {consumed:false,success:false,message:'Fusion unavailable.'};
+  const [a,b]=choice.slots;
+  const enchantments=choice.slots.flatMap(index=>{
+    const item=player.attackSlots[index];const values=item.enchantments|| (item.enchantment?[item.enchantment]:[]);
+    return values.slice(0,1).map(value=>typeof value==='object'?{...value}:value);
+  });
+  result={...result,level:result.level||1,isSynergy:true,consumedWeaponIds:[...choice.recipe.ingredients]};
+  // Draw the first MAX ingredient last, so it is on top of the crossing.
+  const earliest=choice.slots.map(index=>player.attackSlots[index]).sort((a,b)=>(a.maxedOrder??Infinity)-(b.maxedOrder??Infinity))[0];
+  result.synergyTopWeaponId=earliest.id;
+  if(enchantments.length)result.enchantments=enchantments;
+  player.attackSlots[a]=result;player.attackSlots[b]=null;
+  return {consumed:true,success:true,message:`${result.name||result.id} created!`};
+}

+/** Reserve only visible caption ink, accounting for the slot art's top padding. */
+export function levelCaptionSpacing(slotWidth, text) {
+  const glyphs = [...text].filter(letter => letter !== ' ').map(glyphRectangle);
+  const textWidth = [...text].reduce((sum, letter) => sum +
+    (letter === ' ' ? 3 : glyphRectangle(letter).width - 1), 1);
+  const inkBottom = Math.max(...glyphs.map(glyph => glyph.offsetY + glyph.height));
+  const nextBoxInset = slotWidth * (1 - 237 / 255) / 2;
+  return Math.max(0, slotWidth * 0.9 * inkBottom / textWidth - 6 - nextBoxInset);
+}
+
+/** Keep the equipment frame 2px below the lowest visible attack-level outline. */
+function updateCaptionRowSpacing(container, entries) {
+  const visible=entries.filter(entry=>!entry.caption.hidden);
+  if(!visible.length){container.style.setProperty('--level-space','0px');return;}
+  const textWidth=text=>[...text].reduce((sum,letter)=>sum+(letter===' '?3:glyphRectangle(letter).width-1),1);
+  // Scale the entire row together. Fitting each label independently makes LV1 and LV7
+  // different heights because their digit glyphs have different widths.
+  const scale=Math.min(...visible.map(entry=>entry.slot.getBoundingClientRect().width*.9/textWidth(entry.captionText)));
+  let spacing = 0;
+  for (const entry of visible) {
+    entry.caption.style.width=`${textWidth(entry.captionText)*scale}px`;
+    entry.caption.style.height=`${20*scale}px`;
+    const inkBottom=Math.max(...[...entry.captionText].filter(letter=>letter!==' ').map(letter=>{
+      const glyph=glyphRectangle(letter);return glyph.offsetY+glyph.height;
+    }));
+    const nextBoxInset=entry.slot.getBoundingClientRect().width*(1-237/255)/2;
+    spacing=Math.max(spacing,inkBottom*scale-6-nextBoxInset);
+  }
+  container.style.setProperty('--level-space', `${spacing}px`);
+}

+import { knockbackSettings } from './game-config.js';
+import { getCombatHitbox, segmentHitsBody } from './combat-hitboxes.js';
+
+/** Age resistance in gameplay seconds, retaining any configured base resistance. */
+export function updateKnockbackResistance(enemy, delta) {
+  if (enemy.knockbackIdleSeconds === undefined) return;
+  enemy.knockbackIdleSeconds += Math.max(0, delta);
+  if (enemy.knockbackIdleSeconds >= knockbackSettings.resetSeconds - 1e-8) enemy.knockbackResistanceBonus = 0;
+  enemy.knockbackResistance = Math.min(knockbackSettings.maxResistance,
+    Math.max(0, enemy.baseKnockbackResistance || 0) + (enemy.knockbackResistanceBonus || 0));
+}
+
+/** Scale speed by existing resistance, then add a stack for subsequent knockbacks. */
+export function beginKnockback(enemy, dx, dy, duration, { ignoreKnockbackResistance = false } = {}) {
+  // Absolute immunity also blocks attacks that bypass resistance.
+  if (enemy.knockbackImmune || !(duration > 0) || !(Math.hypot(dx, dy) > 0)) return null;
+  updateKnockbackResistance(enemy, 0);
+  const resistance = Math.min(knockbackSettings.maxResistance,
+    Math.max(0, enemy.baseKnockbackResistance || 0) + (enemy.knockbackResistanceBonus || 0));
+  const scale = ignoreKnockbackResistance ? 1 : 1 - resistance;
+  enemy.knockbackResistanceBonus = Math.min(knockbackSettings.maxResistance,
+    Math.round(((enemy.knockbackResistanceBonus || 0) + knockbackSettings.resistancePerHit) * 1e6) / 1e6);
+  enemy.knockbackIdleSeconds = 0;
+  enemy.knockbackResistance = Math.min(knockbackSettings.maxResistance,
+    Math.max(0, enemy.baseKnockbackResistance || 0) + enemy.knockbackResistanceBonus);
+  return { dx: dx * scale, dy: dy * scale, duration, elapsed: 0, applied: 0, stopped: false };
+}
+
+/** Stop displacement without removing an independent stun or contact recovery timer. */
+export function stopEnemyKnockback(enemy) {
+  if (enemy.skillKnockback) enemy.skillKnockback.stopped = true;
+  if (enemy.contactReaction) enemy.contactReaction.stopped = true;
+}
+
+/** Travel at constant effect speed until duration expires or the mover reports collision. */
+export function advanceKnockback(enemy, motion, delta, move) {
+  motion.elapsed += Math.max(0, delta);
+  const progress = Math.min(1, motion.elapsed / motion.duration);
+  const step = progress - motion.applied;
+  if (!motion.stopped && step > 0 && move(enemy, motion.dx * step, motion.dy * step) === false) motion.stopped = true;
+  motion.applied = progress;
+  return !motion.stopped && progress < 1;
+}
+
+/** Sweep living enemies and sample solid scenery; never slide or pass through a collision. */
+export function createKnockbackMover(getEnemies, isClear) {
+  return (enemy, dx, dy) => {
+    const start = getCombatHitbox(enemy, true);
+    const length = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
+    if (!length) return true;
+    const candidates = getEnemies().filter(other => other !== enemy && (!enemy.id || other.id !== enemy.id))
+      .map(other => ({ other, body: getCombatHitbox(other, true) }))
+      .filter(({ body }) => Math.abs(body.x - start.x) <= Math.abs(dx) + body.rx + start.rx &&
+        Math.abs(body.y - start.y) <= Math.abs(dy) + body.ry + start.ry);
+    const stepSize = Math.max(.25, Math.min(knockbackSettings.collisionStep, start.rx / 2, start.ry / 2));
+    const steps = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(length / stepSize));
+    const stepX = dx / steps, stepY = dy / steps;
+    for (let i = 0; i < steps; i++) {
+      const x = enemy.x + stepX, y = enemy.y + stepY;
+      const body = getCombatHitbox({ ...enemy, x, y }, true);
+      const previous = getCombatHitbox(enemy, true);
+      const hit = candidates.find(({ body: other }) => segmentHitsBody({ ...other,
+        rx: other.rx + body.rx, ry: other.ry + body.ry }, previous.x, previous.y, body.x, body.y));
+      if (hit || !isClear(enemy, x, y)) {
+        stopEnemyKnockback(enemy);
+        if (hit) stopEnemyKnockback(hit.other);
+        return false;
+      }
+      enemy.x = x; enemy.y = y;
+    }
+    return true;
+  };
+}

+/** Offer only the next upgrade for an equipped, implemented weapon. */

+  ensurePlayerStats(player);
+  const weapon = getUmbrella(player);
+  if (!weapon) return [];
+  const level = weapon.level || 1;
+  if (level < umbrellaUpgradeSettings.maxLevel) return [{ id: 'umbrella-level',
+    name: `Plana's Umbrella ${upgradeLevelLabel(weapon,umbrellaUpgradeSettings.maxLevel)}`, weapon, category: 'Weapon', description: descriptions[level + 1] }];

+  2:'Increase damage by 20%.',3:'Fire twice per base attack cycle.',4:'Increase damage by 30%.',
+  5:'Fire three times per base attack cycle.',6:'Add knockback on hit.',7:'Fire four times per base attack cycle.'
+};
+
+/** Offer acquisition or the next Aris upgrade, plus existing umbrella choices. */
+export function rollLevelUpgrades(player) {
+  ensurePlayerStats(player);
+  const choices = umbrellaChoices(player);
+  // Fusion ingredients stay out of the upgrade pool while their synergy is equipped.
+  const blocked=new Set((player.attackSlots||[]).filter(Boolean).flatMap(item=>
+    item.consumedWeaponIds||(item.id==='princess-key'?['aris-laser','luminous-nova']:[])));
+  const weapon = getArisWeapon(player);
+  if (!blocked.has('aris-laser') && !weapon && (player.attackSlots || []).filter(Boolean).length < 6) choices.push({
+    id: 'aris-new', name: "Supernova LV 1", weapon: createArisWeapon(), category: 'NEW Weapon',
+    description: 'Shoot a powerful piercing laser beam every 3 seconds.'
+  });
+  else if (!blocked.has('aris-laser') && weapon && (weapon.level || 1) < arisWeaponSettings.maxLevel) choices.push({
+    id: 'aris-level', name: `Supernova ${upgradeLevelLabel(weapon,arisWeaponSettings.maxLevel)}`, weapon, category: 'Weapon',
+    description: arisDescriptions[(weapon.level || 1) + 1]
+  });
+  const luminous=getLuminousNova(player);
+  if(!blocked.has('luminous-nova')&&!luminous&&(player.attackSlots||[]).filter(Boolean).length<6)choices.push({
+    id:'luminous-new',name:'Luminous Nova LV 1',weapon:createLuminousNovaWeapon(),category:'NEW Weapon',
+    description:'Fire a fast, piercing pink plasma round at a random target.'});
+  else if(!blocked.has('luminous-nova')&&luminous&&(luminous.level||1)<luminousNovaSettings.maxLevel)choices.push({
+    id:'luminous-level',name:`Luminous Nova ${upgradeLevelLabel(luminous,luminousNovaSettings.maxLevel)}`,weapon:luminous,category:'Weapon',
+    description:luminousDescriptions[(luminous.level||1)+1]});
+  // Synergies improve only through Crafter enhancements, never level-up choices.
+  return choices.filter(choice=>!choice.weapon?.isSynergy).slice(0, levelUpgradeSettings.choices);
+}
+
+/** Advance one weapon level; awakening is available only through a Crafter. */
+export function applyLevelUpgrade(player, id) {
+  ensurePlayerStats(player);
+  if (player.pendingUpgrades <= 0 || !rollLevelUpgrades(player).some(choice => choice.id === id)) return false;
+  const weapon = id.startsWith('luminous-')?getLuminousNova(player):id.startsWith('aris-') ? getArisWeapon(player) : getUmbrella(player);
+  if (id === 'aris-new'||id==='luminous-new') {
+    player.attackSlots ??= [];
+    const empty = player.attackSlots.findIndex(item => !item);
+    const acquired=id==='luminous-new'?createLuminousNovaWeapon():createArisWeapon();
+    if (empty >= 0) player.attackSlots[empty] = acquired;
+    else player.attackSlots.push(acquired);
+  } else if (id === 'aris-level') weapon.level = Math.min(arisWeaponSettings.maxLevel, (weapon.level || 1) + 1);
+  else if(id==='luminous-level')weapon.level=Math.min(luminousNovaSettings.maxLevel,(weapon.level||1)+1);
+  else if (id === 'umbrella-level') weapon.level = Math.min(umbrellaUpgradeSettings.maxLevel, (weapon.level || 1) + 1);
+  else return false;
+  recordWeaponMax(player,weapon);
+  player.pendingUpgrades--;
+  return true;
+}

+  return Math.max(0,Math.min(Math.round(damageDealt*skill.damageFraction),Math.floor(baseAttack*skill.attackCapMultiplier)));

+/** Nominal281% ATK before the normal damage roll; the banked extra is calculated separately. */
+export function luminousNovaFinisherBaseDamage(player) {
+  return Math.max(0,Math.round(damageRules.baseScale*skill.finisherAttackMultiplier*totalCharacterATK(player)/100));

+/** Own the25s aura, temporary stats, accepted-damage bank and charged finishing shot. */
+export function createLuminousNovaSkill({random=Math.random}={}) {

+  function cast(player,angle,getAngle=()=>angle) {

+    context.fillStyle=glow;context.strokeStyle='#ffb6ec';context.lineWidth=3;context.shadowColor='#ff70d5';context.shadowBlur=12;
+    context.beginPath();context.arc(0,0,radius,0,Math.PI*2);context.fill();context.stroke();context.restore();
+  }
+  /** Fade the gun out from behind the player, charge its muzzle, then retract after firing. */
+  function draw(context,camera) {
+    drawAura(context,camera);drawBurst(context,camera);if(!state||state.phase==='aura')return;
+    const body=getCombatHitbox(state.owner,false),smooth=t=>{t=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,t));return t*t*(3-2*t);};
+    const progress=state.phase==='opening'?smooth(state.elapsed/skill.openingSeconds):state.phase==='firing'?1-smooth(state.elapsed/skill.returnSeconds):1;
+    if(image.naturalWidth&&progress>0) {

+        context.beginPath();context.arc(formation,0,radius*2,0,Math.PI*2);context.fill();

+    }

+    get auraActive(){return state?.phase==='aura';},

+    get damageDealt(){return state?.damageDealt||0;},get finisherDamage(){return state?.damage||0;},
+    get finishing(){return Boolean(state&&state.phase!=='aura'&&(state.phase!=='firing'||state.elapsed<skill.returnSeconds));}};

+import { luminousNovaSettings, attackTimeFormula } from './game-config.js';
+import { ensureCombatStats, rollAttackDamage, totalWeaponDamage } from './combat-stats.js';
+import { getAllEnemies, getEnemy, damageEnemy } from './world-state.js';
+import { getCombatHitbox, getEnemyHurtbox, segmentHitsBody } from './combat-hitboxes.js';
+import { applySkillControl } from './enemy-control.js';
+
+/** Equip Kei's automatic weapon and its independent aura EX skill. */
+export function createLuminousNovaWeapon() {
+  return {id:'luminous-nova',name:'Luminous Nova',level:1,maxLevel:luminousNovaSettings.maxLevel,
+    icon:'../sprites/attacks/Weapon_Icon_Kei.png',iconRotation:-45,exSkill:true};
+}
+export function getLuminousNova(player) {return player.attackSlots?.find(weapon=>weapon?.id==='luminous-nova');}
+
+/** Fire-rate bonuses are absolute multiples of the base cycle, never cumulative multipliers. */
+export function luminousNovaLevelStats(player) {
+  const level=Math.max(1,Math.min(7,getLuminousNova(player)?.level||1));
+  const fireRate=1+Number(level>=3)+Number(level>=5)+Number(level>=7);
+  return {level,fireRate,interval:luminousNovaSettings.attackInterval/fireRate,
+    damageMultiplier:(level>=2?1.2:1)*(level>=4?1.3:1),knockback:level>=6};
+}
+
+/** Damage levels multiply base damage; flat enhancements split over the base-cycle projectile count. */
+export function rollLuminousNovaDamage(player,random=Math.random,target) {
+  const stats=luminousNovaLevelStats(player);
+  return rollAttackDamage(player,totalWeaponDamage(player,'luminous-nova',luminousNovaSettings.damageMultiplier,
+    [(stats.damageMultiplier-1)*100],{projectileCount:stats.fireRate,hitCooldownFrames:10}),random,{target});
+}
+
+/** Sweep the spherical head so fast plasma rounds cannot tunnel past enemies. */
+export function luminousNovaHits(enemy,from,to,radius=luminousNovaSettings.bulletDiameter/2*luminousNovaSettings.bloomRadiusScale) {
+  const body=getEnemyHurtbox(enemy);
+  return segmentHitsBody({...body,rx:body.rx+radius,ry:body.ry+radius},from.x,from.y,to.x,to.y);
+}

+/** Independent aimed, unlimited-piercing automatic plasma weapon. */
+export function createLuminousNovaAttack({random=Math.random}={}) {
+  const s=luminousNovaSettings;
+  let owner=null,cooldown=0,bullets=[],enabled=true,shots=0,skillFinishing=false;
+  function reset(){owner=null;cooldown=0;bullets=[];shots=0;}
+  function fire(player,aim) {
+    const origin=getCombatHitbox(player,false);
+    // Follow the shared arrow/crosshair aim and keep that direction throughout this shot.
+    const angle=Number.isFinite(aim)?aim:0;
+    const dx=Math.cos(angle),dy=Math.sin(angle);
+    const edge=1/Math.hypot(dx/origin.rx,dy/origin.ry);
+    const offset=edge+s.muzzleGap+s.bulletDiameter/2*s.bloomRadiusScale;
+    if(bullets.length<s.maxProjectiles){bullets.push({x:origin.x+dx*offset,y:origin.y+dy*offset,angle,age:0,travel:0,accelerating:true,hits:new Map()});shots++;}
+    return true;
+  }
+  /** Move and expire each shot independently; pierce all targets with a per-shot hit cooldown. */
+  function advance(delta,player) {
+    for(let i=bullets.length-1;i>=0;i--) {
+      const bullet=bullets[i],step=Math.min(delta,s.duration-bullet.age),from={x:bullet.x,y:bullet.y};
+      // Integrate the speed ramp analytically so acceleration is independent of frame rate.
+      const distanceAt=age=>s.projectileSpeed*(age<s.accelerationSeconds?age*age/(2*s.accelerationSeconds):age-s.accelerationSeconds/2);
+      const distance=distanceAt(bullet.age+step)-distanceAt(bullet.age);
+      bullet.age+=step;bullet.travel+=distance;
+      bullet.x+=Math.cos(bullet.angle)*distance;bullet.y+=Math.sin(bullet.angle)*distance;
+      for(const enemy of getAllEnemies()) {
+        if(bullet.age-(bullet.hits.get(enemy.id)??-Infinity)<s.hitCooldown-1e-8||!luminousNovaHits(enemy,from,bullet))continue;
+        bullet.hits.set(enemy.id,bullet.age); // A missed hit cannot retry every frame.
+        const hit=rollLuminousNovaDamage(player,random,enemy);
+        const landed=damageEnemy(enemy.id,hit.damage,player,hit.type,{canMiss:true});
+        const living=getEnemy(enemy.id);
+        if(landed!==false&&living&&luminousNovaLevelStats(player).knockback) {
+          const distance=s.knockbackSpeed*s.knockbackSeconds;
+          applySkillControl(living,Math.cos(bullet.angle)*distance,Math.sin(bullet.angle)*distance,
+            s.knockbackSeconds,s.knockbackSeconds);
+        }
+      }
+      if(bullet.age>=s.duration-1e-8)bullets.splice(i,1);
+    }
+  }
+  /** Stagger shots over the2.5s base cycle; Haste changes cadence, not lifetime or hit cooldown. */
+  function update(delta,player,aim=0) {
+    if(!getLuminousNova(player)){reset();return;}
+    if(owner!==player){reset();owner=player;}
+    if(!enabled||delta<=0)return;
+    if(skillFinishing){advance(delta,player);return;}
+    let remaining=delta;
+    while(remaining>1e-8) {
+      if(cooldown<=1e-8) {
+        fire(player,aim);
+        cooldown=attackTimeFormula(luminousNovaLevelStats(player).interval,ensureCombatStats(player).hastePercent);
+      }
+      const step=Math.min(remaining,cooldown,s.hitCooldown/2);
+      advance(step,player);cooldown=Math.max(0,cooldown-step);remaining-=step;
+    }
+  }
+  /** Draw every active pink round using the shared spherical plasma renderer. */
+  function draw(context,camera) {for(const bullet of bullets)drawLuminousPlasma(context,camera,bullet);}
+  return {ready:Promise.resolve(),reset,update,draw,
+    setSkillFinishing(value){skillFinishing=Boolean(value);},
+    setAutoattackEnabled(value){enabled=Boolean(value);if(!enabled)bullets=[];},
+    get projectileCount(){return bullets.length;},get shotsFired(){return shots;}};
+}

+/** Shared spherical plasma rendering; the EX changes diameter without changing the normal weapon. */
+export function drawLuminousPlasma(context,camera,bullet,diameter=luminousNovaSettings.bulletDiameter,duration=luminousNovaSettings.duration) {
+  const s=luminousNovaSettings,radius=diameter/2;
+  // Swap pink's RGB channels into cyan-blue while retaining each stop's alpha and brightness.
+  const tint=value=>bullet.color!=='blue'?value:value.startsWith('#')
+    ? '#'+value.slice(3,5)+value.slice(5,7)+value.slice(1,3)
+    : value.replace(/(rgba?\()(\d+),(\d+),(\d+)/, '$1$3,$4,$2');
+  // Skip the whole effect once both its head and longest wake have left the canvas.
+  const reach=radius*(1+s.trailLengthRatio+s.bloomRadiusScale);
+  const screenX=bullet.x-camera.x,screenY=bullet.y-camera.y;
+  if(context.canvas&&(screenX+reach<0||screenY+reach<0||screenX-reach>context.canvas.width||screenY-reach>context.canvas.height))return;
+  context.save();context.translate(bullet.x-camera.x,bullet.y-camera.y);context.rotate(bullet.angle);
+  const fade=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(duration-bullet.age)/.06))*Math.min(1,bullet.age/s.fadeInSeconds);
+  // Only leave a wake along positions reached after acceleration, never behind the muzzle.
+  const wakeAge=bullet.accelerating?Math.max(0,bullet.age-s.accelerationSeconds):bullet.age;
+  context.globalAlpha=fade;
+  context.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';
+  // A broad soft halo and a tighter luminous rim keep small shots bright without enlarging their core.
+  const halo=context.createRadialGradient(0,0,0,0,0,radius*3.6);
+  halo.addColorStop(0,tint('rgba(255,225,252,.95)'));halo.addColorStop(.25,tint('rgba(255,125,229,.75)'));
+  halo.addColorStop(.55,tint('rgba(244,48,186,.35)'));halo.addColorStop(1,tint('rgba(220,35,180,0)'));
+  context.fillStyle=halo;
+  context.beginPath();context.arc(0,0,radius*3.6,0,Math.PI*2);context.fill();
+  context.filter='none';
+  const rim=context.createRadialGradient(0,0,radius*.5,0,0,radius*1.6);
+  rim.addColorStop(0,tint('rgba(255,224,252,.7)'));rim.addColorStop(.45,tint('rgba(255,99,216,.4)'));rim.addColorStop(1,tint('rgba(255,55,196,0)'));
+  context.fillStyle=rim;context.beginPath();context.arc(0,0,radius*1.6,0,Math.PI*2);context.fill();
+  const trailLength=Math.min(radius*(1+s.trailLengthRatio),(bullet.speed||s.projectileSpeed)*wakeAge);
+  const tail=context.createLinearGradient(-trailLength,0,0,0);
+  tail.addColorStop(0,tint('rgba(239,61,194,0)'));tail.addColorStop(.15,tint('rgba(255,80,210,.35)'));
+  tail.addColorStop(.45,tint('rgba(255,130,230,.75)'));tail.addColorStop(.75,tint('rgba(255,200,248,.95)'));tail.addColorStop(1,tint('#fff5ff'));
+  /** Draw a connected tapered wake behind the spherical head, with a narrow luminous spine. */
+  function drawTrail(width) {
+    context.beginPath();context.moveTo(-trailLength,0);
+    context.bezierCurveTo(-trailLength*.65,-radius*width*.2,-radius*1.4,-radius*width,0,-radius*width);
+    context.lineTo(0,radius*width);
+    context.bezierCurveTo(-radius*1.4,radius*width,-trailLength*.65,radius*width*.2,-trailLength,0);context.fill();
+  }
+  // Wide additive bloom underneath the bright tail makes its fading gradient feel emissive.
+  context.fillStyle=tail;context.globalAlpha=fade*.65;
+  drawTrail(2.2);
+  context.globalAlpha=fade;
+  drawTrail(1.15);
+  context.filter='none';drawTrail(.7);
+  // A second thin pass reads as hot plasma rather than a translucent flat tail.
+  drawTrail(.22);
+  // Pure additive light fades to transparency: no opaque sphere, colored rim or hard outline.
+  const light=context.createRadialGradient(0,0,0,0,0,radius*2);
+  light.addColorStop(0,tint('rgba(255,250,255,.95)'));
+  light.addColorStop(.2,tint('rgba(255,235,252,.8)'));
+  light.addColorStop(.45,tint('rgba(255,185,239,.45)'));
+  light.addColorStop(.7,tint('rgba(255,125,220,.15)'));
+  light.addColorStop(1,tint('rgba(255,100,210,0)'));
+  context.fillStyle=light;
+  context.beginPath();context.arc(0,0,radius*2,0,Math.PI*2);context.fill();context.restore();
+
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,34 @@
+import { mapSizeMultiplier, officeWindowInsetSource } from './game-config.js';
+export { mapSizeMultiplier } from './game-config.js';
+// Map zoom is configured independently of actors in game-config.js.
+
+
+/** Physical playable limits for the enlarged horizontal/vertical strip maps. */
+export function stripMapBounds(map, width, height, topPadding = 0, bottomPadding = 0) {
+  if (map.axis === 'horizontal') return {
+    left: -Infinity, right: Infinity,
+    top: map.originY + topPadding + officeWindowInsetSource * height * mapSizeMultiplier / 1086,
+    bottom: map.originY + height * mapSizeMultiplier - bottomPadding
+  };
+  if (map.axis !== 'vertical') return { left: -Infinity, right: Infinity, top: -Infinity, bottom: Infinity };
+  return {
+    left: map.originX + width * mapSizeMultiplier * (map.leftWallRatio || 0),
+    right: map.originX + width * mapSizeMultiplier * (map.rightWallRatio ?? 1),
+    top: -Infinity, bottom: Infinity
+  };
+}
+
+/** Stop the camera at finite edges while leaving the long map axis infinite. */
+export function clampStripCamera(map, camera, width, height) {
+  if (map.axis === 'horizontal') camera.y = Math.max(map.originY,
+    Math.min(map.originY + height * (mapSizeMultiplier - 1), camera.y));
+  if (map.axis === 'vertical') camera.x = Math.max(map.originX,
+    Math.min(map.originX + width * (mapSizeMultiplier - 1), camera.x));
+}
+
+/** Keep enlarged enemy spawns inside physical walls, independent of the camera. */
+export function canSpawnInStrip(character, x, y, bounds, defaultSize = 112) {
+  const margin = (character.spriteSize || defaultSize) / 2;
+  return x >= bounds.left + margin && x <= bounds.right - margin &&
+    y >= bounds.top + margin && y <= bounds.bottom - margin;
+}

diff --git a/Development/midori.js b/Development/midori.js
new file mode 100644
index 00000000..1639821f
--- /dev/null
+++ b/Development/midori.js
@@ -0,0 +1,23 @@
+import { midoriSettings, playerSettings } from './game-config.js';
+import { getCombatHitbox } from './combat-hitboxes.js';
+import { statMultiplier } from './combat-stats.js';
+
+/** Match the configured fraction of the controlled player's current movement speed, including SPD upgrades. */
+export function midoriSpeed(player, baseSpeed = playerSettings.movementBase) {
+  return baseSpeed * (player.movementSpeedMultiplier || 1) *
+    statMultiplier(player, 'spdPercent') * midoriSettings.speedRatio;
+}
+
+/** Roll once per close-range player attack, never for admin damage or distant attacks. */
+export function midoriDodges(enemy, source, random = Math.random) {
+  return enemy.type === 'midori' && source &&
+    Math.hypot(enemy.x - source.x, enemy.y - source.y) <= midoriSettings.closeRange &&
+    random() < midoriSettings.missChance;
+}
+
+/** Aim the foot hitbox at the player's body center rather than aligning sprite anchors. */
+export function midoriChaseTarget(enemy, player) {
+  const feet = getCombatHitbox(enemy, true);
+  const target = getCombatHitbox(player, false);
+  return { x: target.x - (feet.x - enemy.x), y: target.y - (feet.y - enemy.y) };
+}

+import { enemyTypeStats, eliteSizeMultiplier } from './game-config.js';
+import { combatHitboxes } from './combat-hitboxes.js';
+import { normalSpriteSize } from './scene-metrics.js';
+
+/** Mega Mob shares Mob's animation and body geometry, enlarged for mini-boss visibility. */
+export function createMegaMob(template) {
+  return {...template,label:'Mega Mob',miniBoss:true,boss:false,standard:false,special:true,
+    spriteSize:(template.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize)*(template.megaSizeMultiplier ?? eliteSizeMultiplier),
+    combatHitbox:combatHitboxes.mob};
+}
+
+/** Retry blocked/full-population placements; consume the one-shot only on success. */
+export function createMiniBossSchedule() {
+  const spawned = new Set();
+  return { update(seconds, spawn) {
+    for (const [type, profile] of Object.entries(enemyTypeStats)) {
+      if (!['megaMob','megaSweeper'].includes(type) || profile.spawnAtSeconds == null || seconds < profile.spawnAtSeconds || spawned.has(type)) continue;
+      if (spawn(type)) spawned.add(type);
+    }
+  }};
+}
+
+
+/** Mega Sweeper uses the existing Sweeper art/animation at the former elite scale. */
+export function createMegaSweeper(template) {
+  return {...createMegaMob(template),label:'Mega Sweeper'};
+}

+/** Knockback collides with solid map props even though ordinary enemy walking ignores them. */
+function canKnockbackStand(enemy, x, y) {
+  const body = getCombatHitbox({ ...enemy, x, y }, true);
+  const map = maps[currentMap];
+  if (currentMap === 'fourth') return canPlaceIslandLoot(body.x, body.y, Math.max(body.rx, body.ry), map);
+  const bounds = stripMapBounds(map, canvas.width, canvas.height, topMovementPadding, bottomMovementPadding);
+  if (body.x-body.rx < bounds.left || body.x+body.rx > bounds.right ||
+      body.y-body.ry < bounds.top || body.y+body.ry > bounds.bottom) return false;
+  const boxes = currentMap === 'first'
+    ? officeObstaclesIn(map, canvas.height, body.x-body.rx, body.y-body.ry, body.x+body.rx, body.y+body.ry)
+    : currentMap === 'second'
+      ? palaceObstaclesIn(map, canvas.width, body.x-body.rx, body.y-body.ry, body.x+body.rx, body.y+body.ry)
+      : obstaclesIn(body.x-body.rx, body.y-body.ry, body.x+body.rx, body.y+body.ry);
+  return boxes.every(box => body.x+body.rx <= box.left || body.x-body.rx >= box.right ||
+    body.y+body.ry <= box.top || body.y-body.ry >= box.bottom);
+}
+
+/** Validate loot ground footprints against player obstacles, never the enemy obstacle bypass. */
+function isLootLandingClear(x, y, radius) {
+  const map = maps[currentMap];
+  if (currentMap === 'fourth') return canPlaceIslandLoot(x, y, radius, map);
+  const bounds = stripMapBounds(map, canvas.width, canvas.height, topMovementPadding, bottomMovementPadding);
+  if (x-radius < bounds.left || x+radius > bounds.right ||
+      y-radius < bounds.top || y+radius > bounds.bottom) return false;
+  const boxes = currentMap === 'first'
+    ? officeObstaclesIn(map, canvas.height, x-radius, y-radius, x+radius, y+radius)
+    : currentMap === 'second'
+      ? palaceObstaclesIn(map, canvas.width, x-radius, y-radius, x+radius, y+radius)
+      : obstaclesIn(x-radius, y-radius, x+radius, y+radius);
+  return boxes.every(box => x+radius <= box.left || x-radius >= box.right ||
+    y+radius <= box.top || y-radius >= box.bottom);
+}

+/** Stable coordinate-based random values independent of exploration order. */
+function officeRandom(column, salt, seed) {
+  let hash = Math.imul(column | 0, 0x1f123bb5) ^ Math.imul(salt, 0x5f356495) ^ seed;
+  hash = Math.imul(hash ^ (hash >>> 16), 0x7feb352d);
+  hash = Math.imul(hash ^ (hash >>> 15), 0x846ca68b);
+  return ((hash ^ (hash >>> 16)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
+}
+
+/** Build deterministic left/right pity streams, caching only monument indices. */
+export function createOfficeTileSelector(seed = worldSeed) {
+  if (seed === 0) return column => Math.abs(column) % officeTileFiles.length;
+  const streams = { left: [0], right: [0] }; // Zero is a virtual anchor, not a monument.
+  return function tileAt(column) {
+    if (column === 0) return 0; // Keep the starting office clear.
+    const sign = column < 0 ? -1 : 1;
+    const distance = Math.abs(column);
+    const monuments = sign < 0 ? streams.left : streams.right;
+    while (monuments[monuments.length - 1] < distance) {
+      const previous = monuments[monuments.length - 1];
+      let step = 1;
+      for (; step < officeMonument.pityDistance; step++) {
+        if (officeRandom(sign * (previous + step), 1, seed) < officeMonument.chance) break;
+      }
+      monuments.push(previous + step);
+    }
+    let low = 1, high = monuments.length - 1;
+    while (low <= high) {
+      const mid = (low + high) >> 1;
+      if (monuments[mid] === distance) return officeMonument.index;
+      if (monuments[mid] < distance) low = mid + 1;
+      else high = mid - 1;
+    }
+    let weight = officeRandom(column, 2, seed) * officeTileWeights.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0);
+    for (let index = 0; index < officeTileWeights.length; index++) {
+      weight -= officeTileWeights[index];
+      if (weight < 0) return index;
+    }
+    return 0;
+  };
+}
+
+export const officeTileIndex = createOfficeTileSelector();
+
+/** Match Stage 1's enlarged height while overlapping horizontal seams by 2px. */
+export function officeMetrics(viewportHeight) {
+  const scale = viewportHeight * mapSizeMultiplier / 1086;
+  const width = 1448 * scale;
+  return { scale, width, height: 1086 * scale, stride: width - overlap };
+}
+
+/** Query only obstacle boxes near a world region; tiles own no enemy records. */
+export function officeObstaclesIn(map, viewportHeight, left, top, right, bottom) {
+  const metrics = officeMetrics(viewportHeight);
+  const boxes = [];
+  const first = Math.floor((left - map.originX - overlap) / metrics.stride);
+  const last = Math.floor((right - map.originX) / metrics.stride);
+  for (let column = first; column <= last; column++) {
+    for (const [x1, y1, x2, y2] of officeObstacleBoxes[officeTileIndex(column)]) {
+      const box = { left: map.originX + column * metrics.stride + x1 * metrics.scale,
+        right: map.originX + column * metrics.stride + x2 * metrics.scale,
+        top: map.originY + y1 * metrics.scale, bottom: map.originY + y2 * metrics.scale };
+      if (box.bottom >= top && box.top <= bottom) boxes.push(box);
+    }
+  }
+  return boxes;
+}
+
+/** Validate spawns against the office obstacle artwork. */
+export function canStandInOffice(character, x, y, map, height) {
+  return canStand(character, x, y, (...region) => officeObstaclesIn(map, height, ...region));
+}
+
+/** Reuse Stage 3 substepped collision and wall sliding for the office. */
+export function resolveOfficeMotion(character, fromX, fromY, toX, toY, map, height) {
+  return resolveObstacleMotion(character, fromX, fromY, toX, toY,
+    (...region) => officeObstaclesIn(map, height, ...region));
+}

+/** Render only visible columns; horizontal position alone determines their layout. */
+export function drawOfficeWorld(context, map, camera, width, height) {
+  const metrics = officeMetrics(height);
+  const first = Math.floor((camera.x - map.originX - overlap) / metrics.stride);
+  const last = Math.floor((camera.x + width - map.originX) / metrics.stride);
+  for (let column = first; column <= last; column++) {
+    const x = Math.round(map.originX + column * metrics.stride - camera.x);
+    const right = Math.round(map.originX + column * metrics.stride + metrics.width - camera.x);
+    const y = Math.round(map.originY - camera.y);
+    context.drawImage(map.tiles[officeTileIndex(column)].image, x, y, right - x, Math.round(metrics.height));
+  }
+}
